400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind. They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings. A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer. Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found. Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace. Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late. Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn. The FBI was called in to help. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths. Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a Delaware woman vanished in 1996, family and friends discovered her secret life. The appointments secretary to the Governor had carried on an illicit affair with a wealthy married man. Agents suspected that her powerful ex-lover was responsible, but they had little physical evidence to support their theory. Investigators never found the woman's body or the murder weapon. The FBI's only hope was to go undercover, and turn brother against brother.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 90s, Washington, D.C. police were losing the battle against street gangs who enforced their territories with lethal violence. The homicide rate in the nation's capital climbed to the highest in the country. Local police turned to the FBI for help, but agents soon found themselves in the direct line of fire. In the fall of 1994, a gang member walked into police headquarters, killed two FBI agents and one detective, then turned the gun on himself.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery. It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle. With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars. As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign. With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck. The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

I531.46737.schedulesdirect.org.description: The Competitive Shooting division of the National Rifle Association hosts the first Match Director Summit, three days of classroom and range time to get future match directors ready to host America's Rifle Challenge events at their home ranges; then nearly two hundred kids from around the state are at the Tennessee 4H shotgun jamboree; and, a new Colt ProTip with Wyatt Gibson.

I531.46737.schedulesdirect.org.title: American Rifleman TV - Remembering Phil Schreier
I531.46737.schedulesdirect.org.description: Remembering Phil Schreier, Walther F-Series ProX PMM, 95 Winchester.

amc.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
amc.us.description: The Imperial Forces -- under orders from cruel Darth Vader (David Prowse) -- hold Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) hostage, in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) and Han Solo (Harrison Ford), captain of the Millennium Falcon, work together with the companionable droid duo R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) to rescue the beautiful princess, help the Rebel Alliance, and restore freedom and justice to the Galaxy.

amc.us.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
amc.us.description: The adventure continues in this "Star Wars" sequel. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) and Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) face attack by the Imperial forces and its AT-AT walkers on the ice planet Hoth. While Han and Leia escape in the Millennium Falcon, Luke travels to Dagobah in search of Yoda. Only with the Jedi master's help will Luke survive when the dark side of the Force beckons him into the ultimate duel with Darth Vader (David Prowse).

amc.us.description: After winning a European vacation on a game show, Clark Griswold convinces his reluctant family to accompany him. His wife, Ellen, is excited, but daughter Audrey is reluctant to leave her boyfriend behind, while teen son Rusty dreams of meeting girls. After arriving in London, the clan encounters one disaster after another as they travel through France, Germany and Italy, while Clark's attempts to cheer everyone up make things worse.

amc.us.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
amc.us.description: Accompanied by their children, Clark Griswold and his wife, Ellen, are driving from Illinois to a California amusement park. As Clark increasingly fixates on a beautiful woman driving a sports car, the Griswolds deal with car problems and the death of a family member. They reach Los Angeles, but, when Clark worries that the trip is being derailed again, he acts impulsively to get his family to the park.

Brown), have to leave town for a family emergency, there is only one person available to babysit for their three kids: Bob's lazy, carefree brother, Buck (John Candy). While he immediately gets along with the two younger children (Gaby Hoffman, Macaulay Culkin), Buck must change his bachelor lifestyle if he wants to be a responsible caregiver for the angst-filled teenager, Tia (Jean Louisa Kelly).

But a serene weekend of fishing at a Wisconsin lakeside cabin gets crashed by Connie's obnoxious brother-in-law, Roman Craig (Dan Aykroyd), his wife, Kate (Annette Bening), and the couple's two daughters. As the excursion wears on, the Ripleys find themselves at odds with the stuffy Craig family.

america'stestkitchen.us.title: The Cocktail Lab - The Zero Proof Bar

americanheroeschannel.us.description: American code breakers have given the United States an edge in every conflict in American history.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Codes and Conspiracies - Civil War

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Codes and Conspiracies - Freemasons
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Many of the Founding Fathers and 14 U.S. presidents were members of the secret society known as the Freemasons.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Codes and Conspiracies - Brothels
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Bordellos, which have endured for thousands of years, hold secrets involving famous patrons, governments and religion.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Weaponology - Fighter
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Tracing the improvements in engine power, maneuverability and weapons systems in fighter aircraft.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Weaponology - Booby Traps
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Battlefield traps cause both physical and psychological damage to the enemy.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Weaponology - Frags, Pineapples and RPGs
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Portable firepower helps small infantry units pack a powerful punch.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Weaponology - Fire Weapons

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Weaponology - Armored Personnel Carriers

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Forbidden History - The Death of Mussolini
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Mystery still surrounds how fascist dictator Benito Mussolini met his end, before being hanged.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Forbidden History - Hitler's Executioner
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Jamie Theakston investigates Johann Reichhart, a German executioner who killed approximately 3,000 people during World War II.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Forbidden History - Concealed By The Vatican
americanheroeschannel.us.description: The Vatican Secret Archives is a treasure trove of history that is shrouded in secrecy; Jamie Theakston heads to Rome in a bid to gain access.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Forbidden History - The Murder Bureau
americanheroeschannel.us.description: The extraordinary story of the Bulgarian secret department called Service 7, a force that operated in 9 countries.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Forbidden History - The Templars' Truth
americanheroeschannel.us.description: Templar fact and fiction have become blurred by their depictions in book and on film. This program presents a very different picture that challenges head on the orthodox beliefs about an order that angered much of Europe - particularly France.

americanheroeschannel.us.title: Forbidden History - The Real Mary Magdalene

animalplanetwest.us.title: I Was Prey - Wicked Bite

animalplanetwest.us.title: I Was Prey - Silent Scream

animalplanetwest.us.title: I Was Prey - Blood in the Water
animalplanetwest.us.description: A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains; miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.

animalplanetwest.us.title: Swamp Wars - Rattlesnake in My Car
animalplanetwest.us.description: A rattlesnake takes a dip in a pool, while another hides out in a woman's car; Capt. Seifert encounters a blood python.

animalplanetwest.us.title: Swamp Wars - Monsters in the Backyard
animalplanetwest.us.description: A 13-foot python takes a dip in a neighborhood pool on Christmas morning.

animalplanetwest.us.title: Swamp Wars - Florida's Born Killers

animalplanetwest.us.title: Swamp Wars - Deer-Eating Python

animalplanetwest.us.title: River Monsters - Body Snatcher
animalplanetwest.us.description: The rivers of Guyana may host a real freshwater mermaid that the locals call the Water Mama.

animalplanetwest.us.title: River Monsters - River of Blood
animalplanetwest.us.description: Wade comes face-to-face with one of South America's greatest freshwater fighting fish.

animalplanetwest.us.title: River Monsters - Amazon Apocalypse
animalplanetwest.us.description: Wade is on the hunt to find out what was behind the Sobral Santos attack on the Amazon River, where more than 200 passengers were killed on a pitch-black night.

animalplanetwest.us.title: River Monsters - Man-Eating Monster
animalplanetwest.us.description: Wade hunts for the Lau-lau, a creature said to swallow men whole.

animalplanetwest.us.title: River Monsters - Alaska's Cold Water Killer

animalplanetwest.us.title: River Monsters - South Pacific Terrors
animalplanetwest.us.description: Jeremy Wade fights through tropical storms and dangerous jungles to search for a Fijian killer that has been part of the local folklore for years, but there may be more than one.

animalplanetwest.us.title: River Monsters - Canadian Horror
animalplanetwest.us.description: Jeremy Wade investigates rumors of a twenty-foot lake monster that attacks people; with snakes, freshwater sharks and giant sturgeon unlikely possibilities, the answer as to what it is drives Jeremy crazy.

antennatv.us.title: The Jeffersons
antennatv.us.description: "We're moving on up, to the East Side, to a deee-luxe apartment in the sky ... ." This spinoff from "All in the Family" is about literal upward mobility - African- American couple George and Louise Jefferson move into a swanky high-rise building. George is an obstreperous, often rude guy who thinks his wealth should get him anywhere he wants to go. His wife is more levelheaded and often cuts him down to size when his schemes go awry.

George is an obstreperous, often rude guy who thinks his wealth should get him anywhere he wants to go. His wife is more levelheaded and often cuts him down to size when his schemes go awry.

babytv.uk.description: The buggy friends pick some berries for lunch. When one of the berries falls into the water, Butterson jumps in after it!

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: Olly, Kitty, Snail and Dolly perform in stage when Snail's tuba starts making very strange noises. Will they be able to solve the problem.

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Needles, Beavie and Bouncy are at the beach. Needles is busy building sandcastles while Beavie and Bouncy are busy splashing about.

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Ever wanted to play with your food? Now's the time! Come make a face sandwich with cheese and vegetables. It's yummy AND fun!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Good morning! Time to stretch and sing cock-a-doodle-doo! Join the rooster and sing it loud!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Come on and jump, stomp your feet and wiggle your tail along with the mouse!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Want to have some fun? Join the dog on the lake as he wags his tail, sniffs with his nose, claps his hands, jumps, pants and barks!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Elephant and Baby Butterfly go on an expedition under the sea in a yellow submarine.

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Charlie and Number Four set out on a journey to find colours for four flower drawings, encountering four castles and trees on their way to bring rainbow colours and smiles back to the flowers befor...

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Charlie's balloon gets stuck in five trees and above a castle, but with the help of his firefly friends, he rescues the balloon.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Princess Star drops her stardust wand. Charlie tries to return it to her but he can't reach. Blue Triangle and Oval come along and try to help.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie, Square and Parallelogram try to fix a hole in the bridge. Who will be able to fill the hole?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie and Circle play hide and seek. Circle is very good at hiding, will Charlie be able to find him?

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny try to figure out what is hiding underneath the handkerchief. What can it be? Come join them as they solve riddles and play games.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny use their imagination to play wonderful games. Join them as they learn colors, numbers, sizes and shapes!

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny try to figure out which is the odd one out. Do you think you can help them? Join them as they play games and solve riddles.

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Oink Oink! What item is missing in the mixed up airplane picture game? What item is in the 3-of-a-kind game? A clown bowtie!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Play the sound game with Bow Wow to hear a clock's sound! Guess what's hiding behind the hidden picture game? A teddy bear!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Elephant get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola helps a family of bears cross the road, helps a cat off a tall tree, finds out what's in the box grandma has brought grandpa.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Lola learns you need to stop when the traffic light is red, meets a bird on the Ferris wheel, helps Giraffe get to the balloon shop and the park.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal has horns! Come along and learn which animal has a wagging tail and big ears!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal has a woolen fleece! Come along and see which animal has a beak and a funny comb!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: Finding the treasure is important, but so is cleaning the ocean! The girls clean up ocean with the help of a friendly octopus.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a frog in the pond! Splash along and help Mr. Snail solve frog's riddles! Who lives in the water and on land and blows balloons?

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a beautiful bee! Join the bee as she puts the nectar she sucked out of a flower into a honeycomb and seals it up with wax!

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Perry wants to play with Harley but Harley keeps falling asleep. Will Perry manage to wake her up?

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix and Leo play hide and seek with their friends. Leo does a great job of finding everyone. But where is Pix? Will Leo be able to find her?

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli meets HJ the elephant and learns all about what his trunk can do! He drinks with it, sprays water, searches high and low.

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A highly familiar day-to-day object arrives at Zeina's doorstep forgetting what it is used for. Searching for the answer, Zeina and her best friend Roy come up with a new and hilarious use for the ...

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A vase arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused vase discover its true use? S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Five little monkeys jumping on the bed! Can you guess what happens? One falls off and bumps his head! Somebody call the doctor!

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Johnny's bike is making a strange "brr" sound. Mikey tries a few creative ways to fix the problem, but sometimes, the simplest solution is the best. S2 Ep1

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Petite has a serious problem - she can't stop her bike! Who is she going to turn to for help? Mikey of course!

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Johnny wants to ride his bike and fly his kite at the same time. But that's no easy task! Who is he going to turn to for help? Mikey of course!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become traffic officers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a whistle!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become brave fire fighters! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a fire truck! Squirrel is stuck on a tree! S1 Ep18

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? A winner's trophy to celebrate a victory! S1 Ep19

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they find creative ways to play games with a bowl and stick, dancing and spinning the bowl just like in the circus!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam Bam use building blocks and sticks to set up a game where they see how low they can go under a bar. S1 Ep9

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Join BabyTV in this classic version of The Muffin Man that introduces your little ones to the adorable muffin man delivering baked goods all around town.

babytv.uk.description: Squirrel has invited Baby to sleep over. What happens when Squirrel wants to go to sleep but Baby still wants to have fun? S1 Ep26

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby has picked beautiful flowers for sheep but is having trouble flying while holding the flowers. Luckily, he has her good friends. S1 Ep6

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy want to take a bath but it's empty! Cloud comes to fill it up with rain but the water disappears!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends listen to music on the radio as the radio turns into a robot in space.

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends play with a doctor's bag and go on treating a frog, a hedgehog and a bird. S1 Ep10

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Come play ball and see it turn into a hot air balloon! Join the ride, float on fluffy clouds and slide down a sparkling rainbow!

babytv.uk.title: Cuddlies

babytv.uk.description: Join Yum Yum and his friends as they enjoy eating a surprise lunch despite cooking flops.

bbcamerica.us.title: Jumanji
bbcamerica.us.description: A magical board game unleashes a world of adventure on siblings Peter and Judy Shepherd. While exploring an old mansion, the youngsters find a curious, jungle-themed game called Jumanji in the attic. When they start playing, they free Alan Parrish, who's been stuck in the game's inner world for decades. If they win Jumanji, the kids can free Alan for good, but that means braving giant bugs, ill-mannered monkeys and even stampeding rhinos!

bbcamerica.us.title: A Knight's Tale
bbcamerica.us.description: Peasant-born William Thatcher (Heath Ledger) begins a quest to change his stars, win the heart of an exceedingly fair maiden (Shanynn Sossamon) and rock his medieval world. With the help of friends (Mark Addy, Paul Bettany, Alan Tudyk), he faces the ultimate test of medieval gallantry -- tournament jousting -- and tries to discover if he has the mettle to become a legend.

bbcamerica.us.title: Total Recall
bbcamerica.us.description: Douglas Quaid is a bored construction worker in the year 2084 who dreams of visiting colonized Mars. He visits "Rekall," a company that plants false memories into people's brains, in order to experience the thrill of Mars without having to travel there. But something goes wrong during the procedure; Quaid discovers that his entire life is actually a false memory and that the people who implanted it in his head now want him dead.

bbcamerica.us.title: The Running Man
bbcamerica.us.description: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape.

bbcamerica.us.title: The Terminator
bbcamerica.us.description: Disguised as a human, a cyborg assassin known as a Terminator (Arnold Schwarzenegger) travels from 2029 to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton). Sent to protect Sarah is Kyle Reese (Michael Biehn), who divulges the coming of Skynet, an artificial intelligence system that will spark a nuclear holocaust. Sarah is targeted because Skynet knows that her unborn son will lead the fight against them. With the virtually unstoppable Terminator in hot pursuit, she and Kyle attempt to escape.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shetland
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S11 E3 The detectives identify a new suspect with an old grudge against Linden. Emily comes face to face with danger when she confronts her cousin Peter, warning him to stay away from the family - but Peter isn't ready to let sleeping dogs lie. Calder unpicks Graeme's alibi and hauls him over the coals, and the team look at Paddy Rose, who believes Linden euthanised his terminally ill father.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Farm 999
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E2 Inferno in the Fields and the Fight to Save Badgers Police close in on an organised crime gang targeting farms and stealing high-tech GPS systems worth hundreds of thousands of pounds at farms across the north of England. In Leicestershire, a huge barn fire devastates on a family run dairy farm, threatening cattle and destroying vital winter feed. As the flames spread, farmer Blaise and daughter Millie race to save their livestock. In Scotland, reporter Paul Colgan meets farmer Debbie Duffus, as she is reunited with the air ambulance team members who saved her life after a brutal farm accident.

bbconeni.uk.title: Doorbell Detectives - Episode 8
bbconeni.uk.description: When Phil returns home to find someone hanging around his house, he decides to confront him and finds some incriminating evidence on his doorbell footage. Former police inspector Anton Sullivan takes a trip to a garden centre to highlight simple tips that can deter wannabe burglars. And Janet turns Doorbell Detective to foil an elaborate scam when she receives a brand new mobile phone.

bbconeni.uk.title: Escape to the Country - Suffolk and Norfolk
bbconeni.uk.description: Alistair Appleton helps a couple who have never lived in an older home, but who are now ready to fall for a bit of period charm in either Norfolk or Suffolk. With a £270,000 budget and three lively whippets to please, they are after a dog-friendly garden and a slice of East Anglian architectural history to call home. Alistair also meets a willow farmer and discovers how this wonderfully sustainable crop is being woven into the future.

bloombergtv.au.title: The Circuit - Waymo
bloombergtv.au.description: Emily Chang travels to San Francisco to meet Tekedra Mawakana, Waymo's co-CEO. Chang asks Mawakana how a career overseeing technological pivots prepared her for the top job and how she navigates safety concerns, growing competition and building public trust in a technology with much to prove.

bloombergtv.au.title: Insight With Haslinda Amin
bloombergtv.au.description: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

bloombergtv.au.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
bloombergtv.au.description: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa; linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

bravovault.us.description: S06 E01 RSVPeeved As Charleston reels over Thomas' arrest, Kathryn deals with conflicting emotions; Cameran struggles to balance motherhood and her career; the friends gather at Patricia's dinner party, during which they are shocked by the revelation of a secret romp.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E02 Kat's Out of the Bag Cameran gives Eliza an earful about her behavior at Patricia's party; Whitney is in the hot seat over rumors about his relationship status; Chelsea hosts a housewarming party; Cameran spills the beans about Whitney and Kathryn's secret liaison.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E03 Slide Into Your DMs Like... Naomie juggles her clothing company and her family's restaurant empire; as Kathryn opens up about her new boyfriend, Craig becomes the town gossip, spreading rumors about Kat's new man and Austen's girlfriend.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E04 Barking Up the Wrong Tree House Austen has second thoughts about breaking up with Madison; Chelsea learns Austen has been badmouthing her around town; a shocking experience gives Eliza a new lease on life; Kathryn pulls another one of her stunts before the girls' trip.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E05 In Sew Deep Kathryn and Danni leave the girls' trip on frosty terms; Cameran realizes she needs to get back to work; Craig decides to host a party to trick his friends into helping him sew pillows; Chelsea lays into Austen for talking behind her back.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E06 A Salt and Battery To get Austen's mind off his ex, the guys rent an RV and head into the great outdoors; Chelsea steps up her hair game; Eliza tries to mend fences; Cam finally asks for help with Palmer; Kathryn and Danni's friendship is at an icy standstill.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E07 Dick Moves and Dick Pics The guys hit the town in Nashville, Tenn., in their attempt to get Austen over Madison; Patricia hosts a female-only dinner party that is even raunchier than the boys' night out, as the women share some secrets of their own.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E08 New Craig, Who Dis? Shep adjusts to life with his new puppy, Little Craig; Chelsea holds Austen's feet to the fire; Kathryn and Naomie get enlightened; when Cameran hosts an oyster roast for her 35th birthday party, she gets "turnt," and Craig the human gets livid.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E09 Sorry Not Sorry The group decides to take a trip to Colorado to help Cameran rediscover her mojo; Naomie refuses to go; Eliza hosts the gang for a day of skeet shooting at her family's plantation and invites a blast from the past, which backfires big time.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E10 Rocky Mountain High Part One Kathryn confronts Whitney about a rumor; Cameran reveals to Shep that she's invited Madison to her birthday ski trip in Colorado; the trip gets off to a rocky start as a frustrated Craig unleashes his pent-up fury.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E11 Rocky Mountain High Part Two Chelsea, Cameran, Eliza, Danni, and Kathryn hit the slopes for their first-ever ski lesson, while Craig, Austen and Madison go snowboarding; Austen and Madison's relationship heats up; tensions arise during a cannabis-infused dinner.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E12 Who Put the Mad in Madison? After a raucous night in Colorado, Cameran and Whitney hightail it back to Charleston, while the others hit the hot springs; Austen and Madison's road to reconciliation is a rocky one; Madison repeats a rumor that throws Shep and Danni under the bus.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E13 Outfoxed Shep's ultimatum to Austen is tested after he and Madison reconcile; Ashley asks for another chance, and Eliza invites her to the fox hunt; Ashley and Kathryn come face to face for the first time in a year, and the gang prepares for a brawl.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm

bravowest.us.description: Thomas wants to prove that Kathryn and the children should not be overlooked; Patricia takes Landon under her wing and shows her how to make Shep swoon; Thomas hosts a dinner party during which a toast drives the gang apart.

bravowest.us.description: Kathryn appreciates that Thomas finally had her back; JD and Whitney stage an intervention to air their concerns over Thomas' erratic behavior; the gang gets together at the second annual Founder's Ball, where simmering tensions come to a boil.

bravowest.us.description: Salley and Austen attempt to define their situationship; Venita hosts a garden party and sets her sights on Whitner, but it's her old friend Allie who catches his eye instead; Shep reveals details about Allie's dating history.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

byutv.us.title: The Bishop's Wife
byutv.us.description: Dejected by his efforts to raise money to build a cathedral, Bishop Henry Brougham (David Niven) beseeches heaven for guidance, and is visited immediately by Dudley (Cary Grant), who claims to be an angel. Henry is skeptical, then annoyed when Dudley ingratiates himself into the household as his assistant -- and worse, wins the attentions of Henry's long-suffering and kindly wife (Loretta Young). When Dudley continues to intervene in Henry's struggles, the bishop decides to challenge heaven.

byutv.us.title: Fiddler on the Roof
byutv.us.description: A lavishly produced and critically acclaimed screen adaptation of the international stage sensation tells the life-affirming story of Tevye, a poor milkman whose love, pride and faith help him face the oppression of turn-of-the-century czarist Russia.

byutv.us.title: How to Train Your Dragon
byutv.us.description: Hiccup (Chris Sanders) is a Norse teenager from the island of Berk, where fighting dragons is a way of life. His progressive views and weird sense of humor make him a misfit, despite the fact that his father (Dean DeBlois) is chief of the clan. Tossed into dragon-fighting school, he endeavors to prove himself as a true Viking, but when he befriends an injured dragon he names Toothless, he has the chance to plot a new course for his people's future.

byutv.us.title: Miracle on 34th Street
byutv.us.description: Six-year-old Susan Walker (Mara Wilson) is skeptical of the Christmas myth surrounding Santa Claus, a trait she perhaps learned from her mother, Dorey (Elizabeth Perkins). When tasked with hiring the Santa who will pose with kids at Macy's, Dorey enlists a man with the curious name of Kris Kringle (Richard Attenborough) who claims to be Santa himself. His assertions are met with scoffs and threats of institutionalization, but a young lawyer, along with Susan and Dorey, comes to his defense.

byutv.us.title: The Sound of Music
byutv.us.description: A tuneful, heartwarming story, it is based on the real life story of the Von Trapp Family singers, one of the world's best-known concert groups in the era immediately preceding World War II. Julie Andrews plays the role of Maria, the tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey who becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

byutv.us.title: Miracle on 34th Street
byutv.us.description: In this Christmas classic, an old man going by the name of Kris Kringle (Edmund Gwenn) fills in for an intoxicated Santa in Macy's annual Thanksgiving Day parade. Kringle proves to be such a hit that he is soon appearing regularly at the chain's main store in midtown Manhattan. When Kringle surprises customers and employees alike by claiming that he really is Santa Claus, it leads to a court case to determine his mental health and, more importantly, his authenticity.

cbsaustin.us.title: The Price Is Right
cbsaustin.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

cbsphiladelphia.us.title: Let's Make a Deal
cbsphiladelphia.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

cbsphiladelphia.us.title: The Price Is Right
cbsphiladelphia.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

cbsphiladelphia.us.title: The NFL Today
cbsphiladelphia.us.description: Get ready for all of Sunday's game action on CBS with "The NFL Today." Hosted by James Brown, the hourlong show presents a mix of features, highlights, predictions and the latest news from across the league. Analysts alongside Brown include Nate Burleson, Bill Cowher, Russell Wilson and Kyle Long.

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

cinemax.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemax.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end.

cinemax.us.title: I Love You Forever
cinemax.us.description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship.

cinemax.us.title: The Rover
cinemax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him.

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (movie) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (movie) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Trance
cinemax.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (movie) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Epic
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hitcher
cinemaxaction.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders.

cinemaxaction.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Darkest Minds
cinemaxaction.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxaction.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (movie) - 1999

cinemaxaction.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxaction.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (movie) - 2000

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxaction.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (movie) - 2016

cinemaxaction.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
cinemaxaction.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxaction.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
cinemaxclassics.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Night on Earth
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An ambitious executive at a record company, Aaron Green (Jonah Hill) gets what looks like an easy assignment: He must escort British rock legend Aldous Snow (Russell Brand) to L.A.'s Greek Theatre for the first stop on a lucrative comeback-concert tour. Snow, however, has different plans. Learning his true love is in California, the rocker vows to win her back before starting the tour, forcing Aaron to pull out all the stops to get Snow on stage in time. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxhits.us.title: Brian Banks
cinemaxhits.us.description: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Hoot
cinemaxhits.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Isle of Dogs
cinemaxhits.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture.

cinemaxhits.us.title: It's Kind of a Funny Story
cinemaxhits.us.description: Stressed by adolescence, 16-year-old Craig Gilner (Keir Gilchrist) checks himself into a mental-health clinic. Unfortunately, the youth wing is closed, so he must spend his mandated five-day stay with adults. One of them, Bobby (Zach Galifianakis), quickly becomes his mentor -- and protégé, while Craig finds himself drawn to a fellow teen, Noelle (Emma Roberts), who just may be the cure he needs to forget an unrequited crush.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Switch
cinemaxhits.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Mid90s
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxhits.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxhits.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxhits.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxhits.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxhits.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemaxhits.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (movie) - 2005

cinemaxhits.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemaxhits.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (movie) - 2014

cinemaxhits.us.title: Inconceivable
cinemaxhits.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxhits.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemaxhits.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (movie) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: Solace
cinemaxwest.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Buffaloed
cinemaxwest.us.description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemaxwest.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Parental Guidance
cinemaxwest.us.description: Minor-league baseball announcer Artie Decker (Billy Crystal) and his wife, Diane (Bette Midler), get to see their only child, Alice (Marisa Tomei), very seldom. To their surprise, Alice and her husband (Tom Everett Scott) ask them to watch their children so they can embark on a trip for work. It promises to be a fun time for all, until the three young ones turn out to be quite a handful for this old-fashioned couple. Artie and Diane may need to bend the rules to make everyone happy in the end.

cinemaxwest.us.title: I Love You Forever
cinemaxwest.us.description: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Rover
cinemaxwest.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Aniara
cinemaxwest.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemaxwest.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemaxwest.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (movie) - 2020

cinemaxwest.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxwest.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxwest.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (movie) - 1995

cinemaxwest.us.title: Trance
cinemaxwest.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (movie) - 2013

cinesony.us.title: Sydney White
cinesony.us.description: Una estudiante (Amanda Bynes) universitaria une fuerzas con siete inadaptadas para apoderarse del gobierno estudiantil y promover un trato justo para todos los jóvenes.

cinesony.us.title: Baby Geniuses
cinesony.us.description: Dos criminales experimentan con un niño y envían a su gemelo a una renombrada guardería de investigación.

cinesony.us.title: The Water Horse
cinesony.us.description: En la orilla del Lago Ness, Angus encuentra un insólito huevo de caballo de agua, la legendaria criatura de la mitología escocesa. Angus intenta mantener oculta su existencia, hasta que su mascota se convierte en el legendario monstruo del Lago Ness.

cinesony.us.title: Lost & Found
cinesony.us.description: Después de ser atrapados robando, Andy y su hermano menor Mark son enviados con un tío lejano a una isla misteriosa. Pronto descubren que su excéntrico abuelo desapareció sin dejar rastro décadas antes, llevándose el secreto de una gran fortuna.

cinesony.us.title: Planet 51
cinesony.us.description: Un astronauta llega a un planeta donde los habitantes están atrapados en una versión de los Estados Unidos de los años cincuenta.

cinesony.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
cinesony.us.description: Un detective de poca monta descubre algo más que un simple secuestro en su búsqueda de la mascota desaparecida de los Miami Dolphins.

cinevault.us.title: Wild America
cinevault.us.description: The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West.

cinevault.us.title: Jack and Jill
cinevault.us.description: Thanksgiving is usually a happy time, but ad executive Jack (Adam Sandler) dreads the holiday because his twin sister, Jill (also Sandler), makes her annual visit. When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer.

cinevault.us.title: Last Action Hero
cinevault.us.description: Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

cinevault.us.title: Open Season
cinevault.us.description: Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe.

cinevault.us.title: Annie
cinevault.us.description: An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - San Francisco
circlecountry.us.description: Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Bitter Water
circlecountry.us.description: When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Feet of Clay
circlecountry.us.description: The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Dark Star
circlecountry.us.description: Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

circlecountry.us.title: Bonanza - Death at Dawn
circlecountry.us.description: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Courtship of Floyd Smoot
circlecountry.us.description: Kate tries to restore the self-confidence of Floyd Smoot after he is jilted by his mail-order sweetheart, by pretending to be in love with him.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Please Buy My Violets
circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - The Ringer
circlecountry.us.description: Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.

circlecountry.us.title: Petticoat Junction - Kate's Recipe for Hot Rhubarb
circlecountry.us.description: Kate decides it is time for Betty Jo to put down the books and set out to find a significant other.

circlecountry.us.title: Lonesome Dove - Leaving
circlecountry.us.description: Two former Texas Rangers renew their spirit of adventure as they and other residents of a Texas town join a cattle drive to the Montana Territory.

circlecountry.us.title: Lonesome Dove - On the Trail
circlecountry.us.description: Call (Tommy Lee Jones) and Gus (Robert Duvall) are forced into a confrontation with an old enemy who kidnaps and brutalizes Lorena.

circlecountry.us.title: Lonesome Dove - The Plains
circlecountry.us.description: Jake's (Robert Urich) involvement with the Suggs gang reaches a tragic climax; Gus reunites with an old flame (Anjelica Huston).
