motortrendfasttv.us.description: Lloyd was born in 1962 and his dream is to have something old, but in good shape just like himself; Dave's biggest challenge is to stretch the car four inches to give more room for driving, moving the gas tank and a few other necessary improvements.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Last Mopar
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Four years ago, Vinnie Massaro brought his Charger to Kindig It Design looking for some minor improvements, and what he got absolutely blew him away; now he's back to build the biggest, baddest Mopar on the planet.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Bitchin' Coronet
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The 1967 Coronet build continues as the metal work comes to an end and the car moves into the paint booth; Vinnie wanted to go all out on this build and Dave has done some of his most innovative design work to date.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Two Cadillacs, Too Reliable!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: For years Mike has wanted to build a 200-mph Cadillac, and now David has finally agreed to make it happen; they purchase a 1961 bubbletop Cadillac DeVille in Northern California; a Cadillac 500 engine wrapped inside a '73 AMC Gremlin.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Twice the Power, Half the Trucks and Leah
motortrendfasttv.us.description: David Freiburger and Mike Finnegan are back in the junkyard to take the front half of two separate four-wheel-drive vehicles and combine them into one, making one of David's dream schemes come to life.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Rear-Engine Replacement: The Econorado is Born!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: David and Mike mix the He Hate Me '66 Ford Econoline with a 500ci front-wheel-drive powertrain donated (stolen) from Dirt Every Day's twin-engine 4x4 Eldorado, to create the Econorado; Finnegan takes the Blasphemi to the NHRA Winternationals.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - 440 Big-Block Samurai: From the Junkyard to the Road!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: David and Steve built the Super Sammy, a junkyard-rescued Suzuki Samurai that they crammed a 440 Chrysler big-block into right where it sat in the middle of the junkyard; now they're back to find out why Suzuki never offered this engine combination.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - The Ultimate Beater Burnout Machine!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: David and Mike consider themselves masters of burnout-ology; yet they have never actually entered a burnout competition until now; they take a rusted-out '76 Camaro and set out across Texas to show how to scientifically get the best burnouts.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Junkyard Rescue Four-Speed Big Block
motortrendfasttv.us.description: David and Mike take a 1964 Ford Galaxie 500 XL that absolutely needed to be rescued; after a few miles, the car begins to smoke worse than any car in the history of Roadkill.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Cheap Beater Battle: Chevy vs. Ford, Old vs. Newish!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: David and Mike find beaters under $3K; it's a four-vehicle shootout with Chevy vs. Ford, truck vs. car, and old vs. newer; Freiburger chose a 2006 Crown Vic and a 1999 Chevy S-10; Finnegan went vintage with a 1972 Ford Maverick and a 1976 Chevy LUV.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Parking Lot Engine Swap
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A Chevy-powered '74 Jaguar XJ12 needs a new engine; in homage to a previous fiasco, the guys return to a parking lot in Sparks, Nev., for the swap; they then follow a lead to fill the void left by the stolen Mazdarati.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Trading Cars Across Power Tour
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Mike and David drive a new car every day as they trade their way through the 25th Hot Rod Power Tour; each day, they'll swap their junk for someone else's and try to make it to the next stop on the tour.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Junkyard Rescue T-37 Pontiac!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Steve finds a '71 Pontiac T-37 at a junkyard in Idaho; Mike and David take their time reviving a motor that's been sitting for 38 years.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Road Trip Survival: The LUV Is All You Need
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Mike Finnegan and Tony Angelo buy a mid-1970s Chevy LUV mini-truck and hit the road, enduring electrical problems, torrential downpours, water in the engine, and floods.

movieplex.us.title: Oddball
movieplex.us.description: A chicken farmer and his granddaughter train a dog to protect a penguin sanctuary from foxes.

movieplex.us.title: Still Mine
movieplex.us.description: A farmer fights back when local authorities hamper his efforts to build a cottage for his dementia-stricken wife.

movieplex.us.title: Miss Virginia
movieplex.us.description: An impoverished single mother is losing her 15-year-old son to the rough streets of Washington, D.C. Unwilling to see him drop out and deal drugs, she places him in a private school. But when she can't afford the tuition, she soon launches a movement to change the system that is destroying him and thousands of others.

movieplex.us.title: Starting Out in the Evening
movieplex.us.description: A complex relationship develops between Leonard (Frank Langella), an academic novelist of advancing years, and Heather (Lauren Ambrose), a determined, fresh-faced graduate student doing her master's thesis on Leonard's career. Leonard keeps everyone at an emotional distance, including his devoted daughter, Ariel (Lili Taylor), and her unsettled boyfriend, Casey (Adrian Lester). Heather's attention, although motivated by selfish interests, forces Leonard to reexamine his life.

movieplex.us.title: Any Last Words?
movieplex.us.description: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life.

movieplex.us.title: The Moon and Back
movieplex.us.description: High school senior Lydia Gilbert feels lost after her father's death, until she discovers a space opera script written by him. Equipped with a VHS camera and pocket change, she decides to honor her dad and make the script a reality.

movieplex.us.title: Midnight Sun
movieplex.us.description: Sheltered since childhood, 17-year-old Katie Price lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight. Her world opens up after dark when she ventures out to play her guitar for random travelers. One night, Katie encounters Charlie, a young man she's secretly admired for years. As fate leads to a budding romance, Katie desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.

movieplex.us.title: Miss Julie
movieplex.us.description: A baron's frustrated daughter (Jessica Chastain) courts scandal and more when she tries to seduce her father's valet (Colin Farrell).

movieplex.us.title: Dudes & Dragons
movieplex.us.description: An evil, jaded wizard makes it his business to rid the realm of love. Now, a brave warrior and his reluctant brother stand between the good people of the world and a fleet of fire-breathing dragons. (movie) - 2015

movieplex.us.title: Children on Their Birthdays
movieplex.us.description: A 13-year-old (Joe Pichler) develops his first crush while his mother begins a romance with a wholesome mechanic. (movie) - 2002

movieplex.us.title: H Is for Happiness
movieplex.us.description: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again. (movie) - 2019

movies.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
movies.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible Rogue Nation
movies.us.description: With the IMF now disbanded and Ethan Hunt out in the cold, a new threat -- called the Syndicate -- soon emerges. The Syndicate is a network of highly skilled operatives who are dedicated to establishing a new world order via an escalating series of terrorist attacks. Faced with what may be the most impossible mission yet, Ethan gathers his team and joins forces with Ilsa Faust, a disavowed British agent who may or may not be a member of this deadly rogue nation. (movie) - 2015

moviesphere.us.title: La La Land
moviesphere.us.description: Sebastian (Ryan Gosling) and Mia (Emma Stone) are drawn together by their common desire to do what they love. But as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

moviesphere.us.title: Killers
moviesphere.us.description: Three years after a fateful trip to the French Riviera, Jen (Katherine Heigl) enjoys the good life in suburbia with her handsome husband, Spencer (Ashton Kutcher). That comes crashing down, however, when gunfire rings out the morning after his 30th birthday. It turns out that Spencer has not been honest with Jen about his job; he's a deadly spy. Now she must learn to dodge bullets while keeping up an appearance of normalcy.

moviesphere.us.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
moviesphere.us.description: Best friends Audrey and Morgan are going about their humdrum lives in Los Angeles -- until Audrey's ex-boyfriend suddenly shows up with a team of deadly assassins on his trail. Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, the gals soon find themselves dodging killers and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world.

moviesphere.us.title: Miller's Girl
moviesphere.us.description: A creative writing assignment yields complex results between a teacher and his talented student.

moviesphere.us.title: Alice, Darling
moviesphere.us.description: Pushed to the breaking point by Simon, her psychologically abusive boyfriend, Alice rediscovers the essence of herself and gains some much-needed perspective while on vacation with two close girlfriends. However, Simon's vengeance is as inevitable as it is shattering, and once unleashed, it tests her strength, her courage, and the bonds of deep-rooted friendships.

moviesphere.us.title: Into the Deep
moviesphere.us.description: A woman's whirlwind romance with a handsome stranger soon turns into a web of deceit, mistrust and violence aboard his yacht.

The artifact is much harder to find than they expected, and its powers are too much for those impure in heart.

mtv2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
mtv2west.us.description: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

nickelodeonwest.us.description: Once upon a time, in a far away swamp, there lived an ogre named Shrek whose precious solitude is suddenly shattered by an invasion of annoying fairy tale characters. They were all banished from their kingdom by the evil Lord Farquaad. Determined to save their home, not to mention his, Shrek cuts a deal with Farquaad and sets out to rescue Princess Fiona to be Farquaad's bride. Rescuing the Princess may be small compared to her deep, dark secret.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Invitation

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Doctor Hamster's Tortoise
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Doctor Hamster visits the school and brings some animals with her. Binky the tortoise is very popular - but ends up needing to be rescued by Miss Rabbit.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Blackberry Bush
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Move To Music
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle is getting Peppa and her playgroup friends to dance to all different styles of music.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Long Grass
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig has not cut the lawn for ages and the grass has grown very long.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Ice Cream
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream - perhaps a little too much.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Strawberries
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig decide to go and pick their own strawberries at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Little Cars
nickjrtoo.uk.description: First, Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars play centre, where Miss Rabbit is in charge.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clubhouse Shop
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The new club house has a little counter, ideal for playing shop. But what will the children's new club house shop sell.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Igloo
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Rock Garden
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children learn about the weather. There is a new friend for Peppa, and Grandpa Pig is making a rock garden.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mandy Mouse's Birthday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is Mandy Mouse's birthday, and as a special treat, Mandy is going to Cheese World with her friends. It is the most fun ever.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Roman Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George dress up as Romans, make a pebble mosaic and even learn a little Latin.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Holiday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Everybody Sleepover!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and all her friends are having a sleepover - different friends in each of the apartments in the high street. So they play hide and seek across all the rooms.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hospital Sleepover
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Families
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jelly
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Mummy Pig is hard at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Motorbiking
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are in for a treat when they embark on a camping trip to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - A Day With Doctor Hamster
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and Suzy Sheep are spending a day helping Dr Hamster the Vet. They meet so many pets and have such fun.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Weather Station
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends are at playgroup with Madame Gazelle, and the children will be learning about the weather by building a weather station.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Art House Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Robot
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Botanical Gardens
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit shows Peppa's family around the Botanical Gardens.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hop, Skip and Jump!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden and together they learn to hop, skip and jump.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Recorders
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle teaches the playgroup to play the recorder. After lots of practice at home, they put on a concert for their parents.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Charity Shop
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George decide to take all the things they don't use anymore to the charity shop, which raises money to help others.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Sunny Day Games
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Clouds
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's New Dinosaur
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur breaks. With all the additional features surely Dino Roar is a good replacement.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Fruit
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is fruit day at the supermarket, and Miss Rabbit is making fruit smoothies.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Snow
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have fun in the snow. They make footprints, play snowballs and build a snowman.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Daddy Puts Up A Picture
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig has a nice new picture of Peppa and George. Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but the job is not as simple as he thought and soon there is a very big hole in the wall.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Goldie The Fish
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Goldie the Fish does not look happy and isn't eating her food, so Peppa, George and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the Vet.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Pen Pal
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa has a pen pal! Peppa gets letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they love lots of the same things.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Wishing Well
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Pig places a large order of plastic gnomes and a wishing well for the garden, Peppa and George love them but Grandpa Pig is not happy. He wishes they would all disappear.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Canal Boat
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's Captain Daddy Dog's birthday and Mummy Dog surprises him with the gift of a boat trip, which isn't quite what he had expected.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Stars
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is night time and the sky is full of shining stars. Just this once, Mummy and Daddy Pig go outside to look at the stars. Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Desert Island
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. He realises he misses the sea.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Secrets
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig gives Peppa a special box to keep secret things in.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Best Friend
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa loves playing doctors and nurses with her best friend, Suzy Sheep, and George loves being the patient.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Princess Peppa
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig, but Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed, until they are told a story.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cuckoo Clock
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George love the cuckoo clock, especially when a little wooden cuckoo pops out singing "Cuckoo.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Basketball
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children are taught how to play basketball by Daddy coach. They are soon good enough to take on a bigger team.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Foggy Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family get lost in the fog, but meet some friends along the way.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Super Potato
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr. Potato has come to visit the playgroup and he's brought along his superhero friend, Super Potato.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Children's Fete
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The school roof has a leak, again! The children organise a fete to raise money for a new roof.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Potato Comes To Town
nickjrtoo.uk.description: All of Peppa's town are excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre in town.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Very Hot Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Today is a very hot day. Peppa and George splash about in their paddling pool. Then there are ice creams for everyone.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa's Compost Heap
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Granny and Grandpa use the compost to help their plants grow.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Masks
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle has got another task for the children; making masks.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Gym Class
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mr. Scarecrow
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig build a scarecrow.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Playing Golf
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful minigolf course next door.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lots of Muddy Puddles
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Babies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Dr Hamster's Ant Farm
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep Moves In
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit's Jetpack
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grampy Rabbit's new jet pack shoots off into the distance and he ends up on top of a snowy mountain.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Park
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa Pig goes to the park to play with friends and have new experiences.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Parking Ticket
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that grown-ups have rules just like children - and get told off too.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Big Hill
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Run Daddy Run
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hobbies
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Decorating
nickjrtoo.uk.description: With the building work done, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Space Adventure!
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is back to Granny Pig's historical re-enactment society for a space adventure, as Peppa and George re-enact the Apollo moon landing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Grandpa can't find his old metal detector to look for the key for George's new toy robot lost in the long grass.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Parachute Games
nickjrtoo.uk.description: During playgroup, Madame Gazelle takes everyone outside to play Parachute Games.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Marathon
nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa's Office
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Bug Hotel
nickjrtoo.uk.description: During another visit to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house, Grandpa takes everyone to show them the new Bug Hotel he is building.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Poems
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle introduces the playgroup to the wonderful world of poetry - and the wonderful world of wooly socks.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Buried Treasure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Kiddie Workout
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Club House
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Bull builds a brand-new club house and slide for Peppa and her friends.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - What Babies Do
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's House to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa learns babies are not like dolls at all, and do lots of things every day.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jumping Stick
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Jukebox
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George have been sailing with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Back at the clubhouse, they discover a jukebox - but it is very noisy.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Petting Farm
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Monkey Trees
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her family are visiting an adventure park. Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they have fun working their way around an obstacle course.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Moving In
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the apartment. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hearing Test
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - House Rules
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Health Check
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and more.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Super Potato Movie
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends visit visit the cinema for the first time to watch the Super Potato movie.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Long Grass
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Daddy Pig has not cut the lawn for ages and the grass has grown very long.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's New Dinosaur
nickjrtoo.uk.description: George pays a visit to Mr Fox's Shop after his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur breaks. With all the additional features surely Dino Roar is a good replacement.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is fruit day at the supermarket, and Miss Rabbit is making fruit smoothies.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: It's Captain Daddy Dog's birthday and Mummy Dog surprises him with the gift of a boat trip, which isn't quite what he had expected.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: It is night time and the sky is full of shining stars. Just this once, Mummy and Daddy Pig go outside to look at the stars. Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. He realises he misses the sea.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Secrets
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mummy Pig gives Peppa a special box to keep secret things in.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Best Friend
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa loves playing doctors and nurses with her best friend, Suzy Sheep, and George loves being the patient.

nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig, but Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed, until they are told a story.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Cuckoo Clock
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George love the cuckoo clock, especially when a little wooden cuckoo pops out singing "Cuckoo.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Basketball
nickjrtoo.uk.description: The children are taught how to play basketball by Daddy coach. They are soon good enough to take on a bigger team.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - World Book Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Indoor Adventure
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Chloe's Birthday Party
nickjrtoo.uk.description: At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Being Inspired
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Trampolines
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep decide they want to have a go at trampolining.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Please and Thank You
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when you say please and thank you.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lucky Hamper
nickjrtoo.uk.description: While Peppa and her friends are at Playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a Lucky Hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick loses the remote in the cushions, so journeys into the couch to find it in 'Lost in Couch', then in 'Pat-a-thon', Patrick hosts a telethon to raise money for snails who can't dance. (S1, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: After Patrick eats life-threatening chum, SpongeBob helps him with his 'Chum Bucket List', then in 'Big Baby Patrick', Patrick devolves back into a baby so he can keep his childhood toys. (S2, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Annoyed by SpongeBob for the last time, Squidward goes legal in 'Restraining SpongeBob', and in 'Fiasco!', Plankton steals a Krabby Patty, unaware it's really an art piece by famous artist Fiasco.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Bad reviews lead to trouble in the Krusty Krab in 'Bulletin Board', and then in 'Sandy's Nutmare', Sandy creates the latest acorn-based food sensation, but her tree pays the price for her greed.

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Craig Mammalton learns what it's like to not be the best at something in 'Eye of the Hotdog', then in 'Patrick Takes the Cake', Patrick and a cake hide out in the wilderness. (S1, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: Kamp Koral
nicktoons.uk.description: Camp Master Krabs finally hires a camp nurse in 'First Aid Last Aid', then in 'Night of the Living Stench', all the campers try to win the Stinkiest Camp in the Forest award. (S1, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Thanks But No Thanksgiving: The Stars celebrate Thanksgiving with Bunny's side of the family in Klopnod. (S3, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Bunny's mother visits from the old country in 'Which Witch is Which?', and then in 'Get Off My Lawnie', Granny Tentacles gets her own spin-off show. (S1, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob and Patrick discover a familiar face in 'We Heart Hoops', then in 'SpongeChovy', it's invasion of the faux-chovies when everyone in Bikini Bottom suddenly starts meeping! (S14, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Plankton is frustrated that people think he's cute in 'Say Awww!', then in 'Patrick the Mailman', Patrick crushes the mailman, so he and SpongeBob deliver the mail around Bikini Bottom.

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick and Squidina take care of Granny Tentacles' house in 'Two Pests in a Teapot', then in 'Partial Recall', the Dartfish family adopts Plankton after he forgets who he is, (S4, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick messes with the space-time continuum in 'The Patterfly Effect', then in 'A Space Affair to Remember', Cecil and Bunny celebrate their anniversary in outer space. (S1, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: The Patrick Star Show
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick and Squidina go undercover to investigate a corrupt novelty product factory in 'Patrickle Jokes', then in 'Pat Roast', The Patrick Show presents The Roast of Patrick Star. (S3, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Squidward is so tired before a big audition that SpongeBob and Patrick can't wake him up in 'Snooze You Lose', then in 'Krusty Catering', Mr. Krabs and his crew must cater a high-class fancy party.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Patrick inducts SpongeBob into his society of dullards and doofuses in 'The Nitwitting', then in 'The Ballad of Filthy Muck', Patrick takes his grime to a new extreme, playing around in trash.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Goodbye, Krabby Patty?: Mr Krabs manufactures Krabby Patties on an industrial scale, but it drives a wedge between SpongeBob and Patrick.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Hello Bikini Bottom!: A concert promoter wants to send SpongeBob and Squidward on the road, until greedy Mr. Krabs decides to manage them - and their "world tour" - himself!

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: The Krabby Patty's secret ingredient is stolen and SpongeBob must find it in 'The Patty Caper', and then in 'Plankton's Regular', Plankton is surprised to have a regular customer who enjoys his food.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Sandy's Tree Dome has a flea problem in 'A Flea In Her Dome'. Patrick accidentally takes SpongeBob's donut and feels guilty in 'Donut of Shame', and SpongeBob is washing dishes in 'The Krusty Plate'.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: SpongeBob hears that a ferocious biker gang is coming to town in 'Born To Be Wild', and then in 'Best Frenemies', Mr Krabs and Plankton work together to investigate a new kelp smoothie store.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Sandy takes on SpongeBob in a non-stop week of extreme sports in "Prehibernation Week", then in "Life of Crime", SpongeBob and Patrick borrow a balloon and end up on the run. (S2, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mysterious hooks appear in Bikini Bottom and Mr Krabs warns SpongeBob to stay away from them in 'Hooks', while in 'Mermaidman and Barnacleboy II' SpongeBob wins a big prize! (S1, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
nicktoons.uk.description: Mr Krabs wisely chooses SpongeBob and Patrick to decorate his living room in 'Wet Painters', and then in 'Krusty Krab Training Video', we learn about being an excellent employee.

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

nicktoons.uk.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

revolt.us.description: A mix of the best hip-hop and R&B music videos, from the hottest new releases to favorite throwbacks.

revolt.us.title: Drink Champs: Happy Hour - Miss Jones
revolt.us.description: Queens rapper N.O.R.E. and Miami hip-hop pioneer DJ EFN are joined by guest stars for a boozy and unfiltered conversation where nothing is off limits after a few shots.

revry.us.title: Metro Sexual - The Tribunal
revry.us.description: Langdon's tribunal finally arrives to determine whether he will return to the clinic or be fired for good.

revry.us.title: The Rainbow Bridge Motel
revry.us.description: After reserving their dream wedding package at Niagara Falls, Dean and Darren learn they've booked themselves in a run-down motor lodge sandwiched between two chemical plants run by some guy named Shibbawitz and a Burmese refugee family.

revry.us.title: Boss Up
revry.us.description: A musical about corporate retail, low cunning and the boss from hell.

revry.us.title: Women and Sometimes Men
revry.us.description: Sara goes on a journey filled with laughter, tears, women and sometimes men.

revry.us.title: Trick
revry.us.description: It's lust at first sight when Gabriel (Christian Campbell), a songwriter with Broadway ambitions, runs into Mark (John Paul Pitoc), a hot go-go dancer at a local gay club. They head to Gabriel's place to seal the deal, but are thwarted when Gabriel's roommate Rich (Brad Beyer) arrives with opposing plans for their closet-sized apartment. It's the first of many sexual obstructions in a wild night that leaves the pair physically unsatisfied, but developing an unforeseen romantic bond nevertheless.

revry.us.title: The Happys
revry.us.description: Tracy thinks she has it all -- until she catches her boyfriend cheating on her with a man. As their relationship starts to deteriorate, she soon finds unexpected solace when she befriends a group of quirky residents in her Los Angeles neighborhood.

revry.us.title: A Very Sordid Wedding
revry.us.description: The impact of the Supreme Court's ruling on same-sex marriage equality in the conservative town of Winters, Texas.

revry.us.title: Oscar Wilde
revry.us.description: Oscar Wilde's homosexuality is exposed when he brings a libel action against his lover's father.

revry.us.title: Peridot
revry.us.description: The story of Gabriel, a young male prostitute who forms the most unlikely friendship with Martha, a world renowned author.

revry.us.title: Unconventional - Baby Shoes
revry.us.description: Noah spends Thanksgiving helping his mother Carolyn clean out her hoarder house; Eliza throws a tense dinner party with Margot and Dan to get content for her business.

revry.us.title: Unconventional - Eggplant
revry.us.description: After Carolyn moves in with them, Noah and Dan try to hide their relationship with Adam; Dan's parents come over on Christmas and pressure them to fast-track the adoption process; Margot reveals she's gone off her meds.

revry.us.title: Unconventional - Whiskey Bottle
revry.us.description: After a month off her meds, Margot experiences a manic episode; Eliza discovers that there may be a complication with her pregnancy; Noah and Dan discover Adam has been harboring a secret that may jeopardize the adoption process.

revry.us.title: Unconventional - Honeydew
revry.us.description: With their lives and relationships falling apart, everyone is faced with making difficult choices about the future.

rfdtv.us.title: The Bluegrass Trail
rfdtv.us.description: Alan Sibley and the Magnolia Ramblers welcome Phillip Steinmetz & His Sunny Tennesseans.

rfdtv.us.title: The Malpass Brothers Show - Jody Nix
rfdtv.us.description: Special guest western swing artist, Jody Nix, plays and sings My Confession and Heartaches by the Number, along with songs from The Malpass Brothers.

rfdtv.us.title: The Malpass Brothers Show - Jenee Fleenor
rfdtv.us.description: Special guest Jenee Fleenor, Grammy nominee, kicks things off with Faded Love, Squirrelly Bird, and Wild Side of Me, along with songs from The Malpass Brothers.

rfdtv.us.title: Gaither Gospel Hour - Giving Thanks
rfdtv.us.description: The Homecoming family gather at a cozy log cabin in the hills of Tennessee to express their gratitude! Bill and Gloria Gaither host a heartwarming musical celebration packed with plenty of music, stories, and countless reminders of the goodness of God.

rfdtv.us.title: Gaither Gospel Hour - Count Your Blessings
rfdtv.us.description: The Homecoming family count their blessings in a soul-stirring musical feast, hosted by Bill and Gloria Gaither. They look back at God's faithfulness through music and discover that a spirit of gratitude is good for the soul and makes the world so much better.

rfdtv.us.title: Opry Live - Reba McEntire, Trisha Yearwood, Kathy Mattea, Terri Clark, Suzy Bogguss
rfdtv.us.description: Celebrating Suzy Bogguss' official induction into the Grand Ole Opry and Reba McEntire's 40th anniversary as an Opry member.

rfdtv.us.title: Opry Live
rfdtv.us.description: Performances from Opry members Brad Paisley, Trace Adkins, Lauren Alaina.

rfdtv.us.title: Opry Live
rfdtv.us.description: Opry honors Don Williams. Featuring Keith Urban, Trisha Yearwood, John Foster, Rodney Crowell, Brandy Clark, The Isaacs, Jamey Johnson.

rfdtv.us.title: The Penny Gilley Show - Rick McEwen -- Kenny Rogers Tribute
rfdtv.us.description: Penny Gilley performs country hits from Ft. Worth, Texas along with regulars Bobby Mackey, Dani Daye, Wyatt Aleman.

rfdtv.us.title: The Penny Gilley Show - Craig Copeland, Melody Hart
rfdtv.us.description: Featuring Craig Copeland and Melody Hart along with regulars Bobby Mackey, Dani Daye and Wyatt Aleman.

rfdtv.us.title: Lonesome Dove - Leaving
rfdtv.us.description: Two former Texas Rangers renew their spirit of adventure as they and other residents of a Texas town join a cattle drive to the Montana Territory.

rfdtv.us.title: Lonesome Dove - On the Trail
rfdtv.us.description: Call (Tommy Lee Jones) and Gus (Robert Duvall) are forced into a confrontation with an old enemy who kidnaps and brutalizes Lorena.

rfdtv.us.title: Lonesome Dove - The Plains
rfdtv.us.description: Jake's (Robert Urich) involvement with the Suggs gang reaches a tragic climax; Gus reunites with an old flame (Anjelica Huston).

rfdtv.us.title: Lonesome Dove - Return
rfdtv.us.description: Gus (Robert Duvall) is injured during an Indian attack; Call (Tommy Lee Jones) has a final run-in with Blue Duck.

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: Vengeance of the Dead - RiffTrax: Vengeance of the Dead
rifftrax.us.description: Vengeance of the Dead is the bone-chilling tale of a young man visiting his grandpa, and several other grandpas! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax Presents: Sherlock Holmes and the Woman in Green - RiffTrax Presents: Sherlock Holmes and the Woman in Green
rifftrax.us.description: Originally in black and white, the woman The Woman in Green was difficult to identify — but because of the wonder of colorization, Bridget and Mary Jo figure out who's wearing green almost immediately! The rest of the mystery is elementary.

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax: Invasion of the Animal People - RiffTrax: Invasion of the Animal People

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax Shorts: People Soup - RiffTrax Shorts: People Soup

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax Short: Shy Guy - RiffTrax Short: Shy Guy
rifftrax.us.description: Shyness—for years it has prevented boys from becoming men and girls from landing men.

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax Special: 90s Cyber Thrillers - RiffTrax Special: 90s Cyber Thrillers

rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax Short: A Visit to Santa - RiffTrax Short: A Visit to Santa

screamboxtv.us.description: Skilled ronin Kiba wanders the Japanese countryside and finds himself facing off against a skilled swordsman, a crooked goldmine owner, a manipulative woman and a dojo master.

screamboxtv.us.title: The Last Thanksgiving
screamboxtv.us.description: A family of cannibalistic Pilgrims attacks the staff and patrons at a restaurant that stays open for Thanksgiving rather than close in celebration of the holiday.

screamboxtv.us.title: Bloody Bites
screamboxtv.us.description: S18 E05 Wild Animal In the early hours of the morning, Mallory, a wealthy woman, finds an abandoned baby; she drives the baby to a caravan park and abandons it there to be found by someone else; however, she feels like the child's mother is stalking her.

screamboxtv.us.title: Creature From the Haunted Sea
screamboxtv.us.description: After political unrest breaks out on a Caribbean island, scheming criminal Renzo Capetto (Anthony Carbone) promises to transport a group of exiles out of the country while also taking part of the national treasury.

screenpix.us.title: Romance and Cigarettes
screenpix.us.description: In this musical that features characters lip-synching to classic songs, Nick (James Gandolfini), a Queens, N.Y.-based ironworker, lives with his wife, Kitty (Susan Sarandon), and three daughters. When Nick meets a significantly younger woman, Tula (Kate Winslet), he starts an affair with her, much to the chagrin of his wife, and his life is thrown into upheaval. Kitty kicks Nick out of the house, and he is forced to make some difficult decisions.

screenpix.us.title: Billie
screenpix.us.description: Billie (Patty Duke) is a tomboy who loves sports. When the high school track coach (Charles Lane) sees her run, he asks her to join the school team. Her inclusion in the formerly all-male team causes quite a stir, especially with her father (Jim Backus). He is typically supportive of Billie, but now he worries that her shocking behavior will cost him his bid for mayor. Nervously, he starts setting Billie up with dates, unaware that she has a crush on her classmate, Mike (Warren Berlinger).

screenpix.us.title: The First Time
screenpix.us.description: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them.

screenpix.us.title: Cul-de-Sac
screenpix.us.description: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

screenpix.us.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
screenpix.us.description: While preparations are underway for the marriage of Athenian duke Theseus (Derek Godfrey) and Amazon queen Hippolyta (Barbara Jefford), fairy king Oberon (Ian Richardson) and his tricky jester, Puck (Ian Holm), make mischief with the indiscriminate use of a powerful love potion. Lysander (David Warner) and Demetrius (Michael Jayston) both fall for Helena (Diana Rigg), raising the jealousy of Hermia (Helen Mirren), whose father is pressuring her to marry Demetrius despite Lysander's love for her.

screenpix.us.title: Hawaii
screenpix.us.description: During the 1820s, a domineering young minister, Abner Hale (Max von Sydow), and his compassionate wife, Jerusha (Julie Andrews), embark on a dangerous sea voyage to Hawaii. When they arrive, Jerusha befriends the Hawaiian people and embraces their customs and culture, while Abner, intent on converting them to Christianity, views them as pagan savages. Jerusha grows unhappy with her marriage and begins to fall for Rafer Hoxworth (Richard Harris), a past lover.

screenpix.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: A Matter of Justice
screenpix.us.description: The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) and police chief (Carl Weathers) to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

screenpix.us.title: Feast of Love
screenpix.us.description: The love lives of several people of various ages intersect when a young woman named Chloe (Alexa Davalos) comes to town. Immediately, barista Oscar (Toby Hemingway) is enamored with her and thrilled when his boss, Bradley (Greg Kinnear), hires her. Then Bradley's wife, Kathryn (Selma Blair), leaves him for someone else. Afterward Bradley marries realtor Diana (Radha Mitchell), who helps the first couple move in together. Harry (Morgan Freeman) watches it all quietly and muses on love and loss. (movie) - 2007

screenpix.us.title: Time Limit
screenpix.us.description: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else. (movie) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: Stolen Hours
screenpix.us.description: Laura (Susan Hayward), an American heiress in London, is a party girl living it up, in denial of her serious illness. She rebuffs the concerns of her ex-lover (Edward Judd) and keeps her health a secret from her sister (Diane Baker). Eventually, John (Michael Craig), a handsome doctor, demands she get treatment, and Laura finally listens. Doctor and patient fall in love and move to a house on the Cornish coast. In her dying days, the restless heiress searches for humility, happiness and peace. (movie) - 1963

screenpix.us.title: A Prayer for the Dying
screenpix.us.description: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. Now, Fallon wants out. He's through killing for the cause, but in order to secure safe passage to the U.S., he'll have to take one more job: eliminating rival terrorist Krasko (Stanley Beard). Unfortunately, a priest (Bob Hoskins) complicates matters by witnessing the hit, but Fallon believes he knows how to keep him silent. (movie) - 1987

screenpix.us.title: The Boss
screenpix.us.description: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has. (movie) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Warriors of Virtue
screenpixaction.us.description: Lame in one leg, Ryan Jeffers has few friends in his high school and spends most of his time with Chinese restaurant chef Ming, who gives him the Book of Tao. When he is goaded by the football team into a dangerous ceremony, Ryan falls into a whirlpool and emerges in the magical land of Tao. His leg fully healed, he is led to Master Chung, whose heroic warriors battle against greedy Lord Komodo. Ryan joins their fight.

screenpixaction.us.title: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
screenpixaction.us.description: Round Table knight Gawain (Murray Head) beheads the Green Knight (Nigel Green), who expects a return stroke.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Boy and the Pirates
screenpixaction.us.description: On the beach near his home, Jimmy (Charles Herbert) finds a bottle that contains a genie named Abu (Joseph Turkel), who magically transports him to the ship of the pirate Blackbeard (Murvyn Vye). Abu explains that the bottle must be returned to its original location in three days, or Jimmy will take the genie's place. The pair spend a few eventful days with Blackbeard, evading capture, accompanied by a girl (Susan Gordon) they rescue, but Jimmy begins to wonder if he'll ever get back home.

screenpixaction.us.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant
screenpixaction.us.description: A Norwegian prince fights evil with a rock man's sword of the sun.

screenpixaction.us.title: Jack the Giant Killer
screenpixaction.us.description: Desiring control of the kingdom, an evil wizard, Pendragon (Torin Thatcher), devises a cunning machination to usurp the throne. By abducting Princess Elaine (Judi Meredith) and forcing her to marry him, Pendragon will coerce the king (Dayton Lummis) into abdicating his power. When Pendragon sends a giant to kidnap Elaine, a simple farmer, Jack (Kerwin Mathews), witnesses the abduction, and bravely slays the beast. Undeterred, Pendragon has more power and creatures at his disposal.

screenpixaction.us.title: No Such Thing
screenpixaction.us.description: Disgusted with human evolution, a foul-mouthed monster kills anyone who crosses his path. When a news crew sent to investigate the monster disappears, a guileless young woman is dispatched to follow up on the story. She befriends the monster and becomes his only hope in ending his life of misery.

screenpixaction.us.title: Code 46
screenpixaction.us.description: In a dystopian future, insurance fraud investigator William Geld (Tim Robbins) arrives in Shanghai to investigate a forgery ring for "papelles," futuristic passports that record people's identities and genetics. Geld falls for Maria Gonzalez (Samantha Morton), the woman in charge of the forgeries. After a passionate affair, Geld returns home, having named a coworker as the culprit. But when one of Gonzalez's customers is found dead, Geld is sent back to Shanghai to complete the investigation.

screenpixaction.us.title: Master of the World
screenpixaction.us.description: Mad inventor Capt. Robur kidnaps a team on a government expedition to investigate a mysterious crater in Pennsylvania. The team is taken aboard Robur's spectacularly engineered air ship, the Albatross, which Robur plans to fly around the world to various military installations in his desperate desire to eradicate weapons of mass destruction, thereby bringing about world peace. The kidnapped team's leader, John Strock, responds by planning an uprising.

screenpixaction.us.title: Eve of Destruction
screenpixaction.us.description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

screenpixaction.us.title: Journey to the Seventh Planet
screenpixaction.us.description: An astronaut (John Agar) leads U.N. explorers to Uranus, where a giant eye feeds them images from their minds.

screenpixaction.us.title: Beyond the Time Barrier
screenpixaction.us.description: A pilot crashes through the time barrier into the world of 2024, inhabited by the last remnants of civilization. (movie) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Panic in Year Zero
screenpixaction.us.description: As the Baldwin family heads on vacation, their hometown of Los Angeles falls victim to a nuclear attack. Harry (Ray Milland), his wife, Ann (Jean Hagen), and their two teens head to their fishing retreat in the mountains, hoping to regroup and get more information. But they can't escape the frantic and irrational citizens, most of whom are dangerously deranged. Harry tries to stay calm during the nuclear-inspired end of days, but it's tempting to follow the masses' frenzied behavior. (movie) - 1962

screenpixaction.us.title: Khyber Patrol
screenpixaction.us.description: British lancers court their commander's daughter and patrol the Khyber Pass. (movie) - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: Top of the World
screenpixaction.us.description: A jet pilot finds himself assigned to the barren wastes of Alaska where it becomes his duty to man an observation post. (movie) - 1955

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hurricane Streets
screenpixvoices.us.description: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Gabriela
screenpixvoices.us.description: A rich Turkish bar owner (Sônia Braga) falls in love with his beautiful Brazilian cook (Marcello Mastroianni).

screenpixvoices.us.title: Go Fish
screenpixvoices.us.description: After leaving behind her girlfriend to attend college in Chicago, young lesbian Max West (Guinevere Turner) is introduced to Ely (V.S. Brodie), a slightly older woman with quirky habits. While Max and Ely quickly develop an attraction to each other, a poorly timed phone call from Max's long-distance girlfriend, Kate, brings things to an abrupt halt. Meanwhile, Max's roommate, Kia (T. Wendy McMillan), helps her girlfriend, Evy (Migdalia Melendez), cope with some tough times at home.

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Perez Family
screenpixvoices.us.description: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Love Chronicles
screenpixvoices.us.description: A disc jockey and a therapist help callers on a radio program sort through their relationship issues.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hurricane Streets
screenpixvoices.us.description: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hendrix
screenpixvoices.us.description: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) innovates 1960s rock 'n' roll, then dies of a drug overdose at 27.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Rappin'
screenpixvoices.us.description: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Beat Street
screenpixvoices.us.description: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
screenpixvoices.us.description: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center. (movie) - 1984

screenpixvoices.us.title: Bojangles
screenpixvoices.us.description: Based on the life of tap-dancing legend Bill Robinson -- also known as Mr. Bojangles -- the film follows Robinson as he climbs his way up the entertainment ladder from lowly vaudeville performer to one of the greatest black entertainers of his time. However, despite Robinson's meteoric rise and the support of his loyal agent, Marty Forkins, his compulsive gambling and love of women keep him from enjoying the success his talents have earned him. (movie) - 2001

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hendrix
screenpixvoices.us.description: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix (Wood Harris) innovates 1960s rock 'n' roll, then dies of a drug overdose at 27. (movie) - 2000

screenpixvoices.us.title: Rappin'
screenpixvoices.us.description: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music. (movie) - 1985

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Wanda Nevada
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the American Southwest of the 1950s, middle-aged vagabond Beaudray Demerille (Peter Fonda) survives as a cardsharp who moves from town to town. But his latest victory brings him unwanted spoils in the form of Wanda Nevada (Brooke Shields), a fiery 13-year-old. At first Beaudray does everything he can to ditch Wanda -- until the girl chances upon a treasure map. But Wanda and Beaudray aren't the only ones after the loot, and they must contend with a ruthless pair of crooks.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Dog's Best Friend
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Belle of the Yukon
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Sam Whiskey
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Another Man, Another Chance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When Jeanne (Geneviève Bujold), a young woman, falls for a photographer named Francis (Francis Huster), he convinces her to leave war-torn France and move to America with him. After they have set up a photography shop and have a baby, Francis dies. A few years later, Jeanne meets David (James Caan), a solitary man who cannot forget the murder of his wife. Jeanne and David start a relationship, but she worries that his dangerous search for his wife's killers threatens their love.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Conspiracy
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A bartender is killed after he takes on another identity and sells a scandal-ridden story to a newspaper.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Black Pearls
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat agrees to pose as a prisoner to gain the confidence of a criminal who hid a string of black pearls he stole, but when the man's sister arrives his job gets harder.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Kidnapping
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hope Jensen turns in a bag of stolen money that her husband had been forced to hide in their barn by Ben Jensen and his gang.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Girl from Philadelphia
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Belle Reed's sister poses as her, with hopes of trapping her killer.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Revolt at Fort Laramie
screenpixwesterns.us.description: At the dawn of the American Civil War, tensions begin to mount between Northern and Southern sympathizers stationed at Fort Laramie in Wyoming. The Southern soldiers, led by Maj. Seth Bradner (John Dehner), leave Fort Laramie to join the Confederate cause. But when Bradner is captured by a fortune-seeking Sioux tribe en route to Texas, it's up to Capt. James Tenslip (Gregg Palmer), a Northerner who has fallen for Bradner's niece Melissa (Frances Helm), to save him.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Frontier Uprising
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Defiance
screenpixwesterns.us.description: After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Drango
screenpixwesterns.us.description: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen. A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening. (movie) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Fort Yuma
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Apaches plan to attack a fort by wearing uniforms plundered from a cavalry officer's (Peter Graves) supply column. (movie) - 1955

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Geronimo
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Apache leader Geronimo (Chuck Connors) tires of battling American and Mexican troops, and decides to surrender his meager tribe. However, life on the San Carlos reservation is difficult, and the Apaches do not adjust well to becoming farmers. Geronimo is befriended by a schoolteacher (Kamala Devi), who tries to broaden his horizons, but corruption on the reservation forces him to take his band and head for the mountains, where the Apaches wage a doomed war against the white man. (movie) - 1962

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Outlaw's Son
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Young Jeff Blaine (Joseph Stafford) is being raised by his Aunt Ruth (Ellen Drew) because his absentee father, Nate (Dane Clark), is an outlaw. When Nate suddenly shows up, hoping to get custody of Jeff, Ruth opposes the idea, and forces Nate to flee by framing him for a robbery. Years later, the adult Jeff (Ben Cooper), who never forgave Ruth for her deception, begins to search for his fugitive father, and becomes an outlaw himself when he engages in an ill-advised stagecoach robbery. (movie) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Conspiracy
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A bartender is killed after he takes on another identity and sells a scandal-ridden story to a newspaper. (Western) - 1959-06-24

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Black Pearls
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat agrees to pose as a prisoner to gain the confidence of a criminal who hid a string of black pearls he stole, but when the man's sister arrives his job gets harder. (Western) - 1959-07-01

scrippsnews.us.title: Edge of Extinction: The Last Vaquita ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
scrippsnews.us.description: Exclusive access to the frontlines of a fight to save the world's most endangered marine mammal: the vaquita.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Shaquille O'Neal
scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Kristen Bell
scrippsnews.us.description: Actress Kristen Bell recounts how her nurturing nature and her good works, such as co-founding No Kid Hungry, was sparked when she was age 19 and helped deliver two babies during a missionary trip to a clinic in Brazil.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Samuel L. Jackson & LaTanya Richardson Jackson
scrippsnews.us.description: Actors/spouses Samuel and LaTanya Jackson have fought for civil rights around the globe, but their greatest satisfaction comes from handwritten thank you notes from children they have supplied with books.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - LeVar Burton
scrippsnews.us.description: Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Joe Namath
scrippsnews.us.description: Joe Namath grew up in Beaver Falls, Pennsylvania, near Pittsburgh. After his parents' divorce, Joe turned to sports; he was propelled into sports stardom in college and professional football earning the nickname Broadway Joe.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Shaquille O'Neal
scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.title: Connected With Alisyn Camerota
scrippsnews.us.description: Former Hamas hostage Eli Sharabi opens up to Alisyn about his survival in captivity.

scrippsnews.us.title: Connected With Alisyn Camerota
scrippsnews.us.description: Journalist Don Lemon opens up to Alisyn about his departure from CNN, his new media venture and being targeted by President Trump's DOJ.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Savannah's Top Banana
scrippsnews.us.description: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans and true fun are the whole point? Jesse opens up about being nearly $2 million in debt and the critics who were certain he was out of his mind - right up until he wasn't.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Off Mic
scrippsnews.us.description: For four decades, sports broadcasting pioneers Suzy Kolber and Lisa Salters have told everyone else's story. The championship runs. The comebacks. The night Damar Hamlin's heart stopped, and millions hung on their every word. Through all of it, their own stories - flourishing in a male-dominated business, juggling single motherhood with a demanding career - stayed off the mic. Until now.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Dual Threat
scrippsnews.us.description: Steve Young redefined the quarterback position, setting records as both passer and rusher during his Hall of Fame career; behind the scenes, he battled crippling anxiety that was tougher than any opponent; when football was over, he built a $10 billion business from scratch; Suzy Kolber reconnects with her former broadcast partner to find out what it takes to be a dual threat — on the field and in life.

scrippsnews.us.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber - Gruden: A Love Story
scrippsnews.us.description: Few people love anything more than Jon Gruden loves football. Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. Jon reflects on the philosophy that drove every reinvention—including how he's navigated life since his coaching career came to a sudden end—and whether the sideline is still calling.

scrippsnews.us.description: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from."

scrippsnews.us.description: Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

scrippsnews.us.title: Beyond the Spotlight - Joe Namath
scrippsnews.us.description: Joe Namath grew up in Beaver Falls, Pennsylvania, near Pittsburgh. After his parents' divorce, Joe turned to sports; he was propelled into sports stardom in college and professional football earning the nickname Broadway Joe.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 1 Bulldogs (12-0, 8-0) try to solve the No. 3 Crimson Tide (11-1, 7-1) in the SEC title game. Alabama has won six straight meetings since 2008, including the 2012 and 2018 SEC title tilts as well as the 2018 national championship game.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: LSU vs. Georgia
secnetwork.us.description: The Bulldogs face the Tigers in the 2022 SEC Championship Game from Atlanta. This is a rematch of the 2019 edition where Joe Burrow and LSU bested Georgia 37-10 en route to a national title. Georgia's last loss came in a 2021 match against Alabama.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama
secnetwork.us.description: No. 1 Georgia plays No. 8 Alabama in the SEC Championship game. This marks the first meeting since the Bulldogs beat the Crimson Tide in the 2021 national championship game. The two schools have combined to win eight of the past nine SEC titles.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Texas
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 2 Longhorns (11-1) try to exact revenge on the No. 5 Bulldogs (10-2) in the SEC championship game. Georgia won at Texas 30-15 on Oct. 19. The Bulldogs make their fourth consecutive title-game appearance. Georgia defeated LSU 50-30 in 2022.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - SEC Championship: Georgia vs. Alabama

Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge.

showtime.us.title: Saving Private Ryan
showtime.us.description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

showtime.us.title: Dunkirk
showtime.us.description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found. (Movies, War) - 2017

showtime.us.title: Behind Enemy Lines
showtime.us.description: A Navy admiral (Gene Hackman) orders the rescue of a fighter pilot (Owen Wilson) after the Serbs shoot down his plane in Bosnia. (Movies, Action) - 2001

showtime2west.us.title: Risky Business
