As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. starzinblack.us.title: Ray
starzinblack.us.description: Legendary soul musician Ray Charles is portrayed by Jamie Foxx in this Oscar-winning biopic. Young Ray watches his 7-year-old brother drown at age seven. When he loses his sight at the age of 9, his hardworking mother (Sharon Warren) urges him not to feel sorry for himself. He rises through the ranks of the Seattle jazz scene, struggling with drug addiction and infidelity while on the road. Supported by his wife (Kerry Washington), Ray Charles redefines soul music and inspires a generation.

starzinblack.us.title: Undercover Brother
starzinblack.us.description: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash.

Cornell Cobbs (Forest Whitaker) and his wife, Aretha (Angela Bassett). However, Langston soon finds that Cobbs has strict rules, and the youth is unwilling to follow them. starzinblack.us.title: Ray

He rises through the ranks of the Seattle jazz scene, struggling with drug addiction and infidelity while on the road. Supported by his wife (Kerry Washington), Ray Charles redefines soul music and inspires a generation. (movie) - 2004

starzwest.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

starzwest.us.title: Jurassic World
starzwest.us.description: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the Jurassic World luxury resort provides a habitat for an array of genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex. When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.

starzwest.us.title: Alarum

starzwest.us.title: Beast
starzwest.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built.

starzwest.us.title: The Preacher's Wife

starzwest.us.title: In the Grey
starzwest.us.description: A covert team of elite operatives live in the global shadows, as comfortable wielding power and influence as they are automatic weapons and high explosives. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, the team is sent to steal it back on what would be for anyone else a suicide mission. What begins as an impossible heist gets worse, spiraling into an all-out war of strategy, deception and survival.

starzwest.us.title: Fifty Shades of Grey (Extended Version)
starzwest.us.description: When college senior Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) steps in for her sick roommate to interview prominent businessman Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan) for their campus paper, little does she realize the path her life will take. Christian, as enigmatic as he is rich and powerful, finds himself strangely drawn to Ana, and she to him. Though sexually inexperienced, Ana plunges headlong into an affair -- and learns that Christian's true sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.

starzwest.us.title: Fifty Shades Darker: Extended Version
starzwest.us.description: When a wounded Christian Grey tries to entice a cautious Anastasia Steele back into his life, she demands a new arrangement before she will give him another chance. As the two begin to build trust and find stability, shadowy figures from Christian's past start to circle them, determined to destroy their hopes for a future together. (movie) - 2017

starzwest.us.title: Fifty Shades Freed: Extended Version
starzwest.us.description: Believing they've left behind the shadowy figures from the past, billionaire Christian Grey and his new wife, Anastasia, fully embrace their inextricable connection and shared life of luxury. Just as the Greys begin to step into their new roles, sinister events come to light and jeopardize their happy ending before it even begins. (movie) - 2018

syfy.us.description: A disaffected magazine intern (Aubrey Plaza) befriends an unusual guy (Mark Duplass), who is looking for a partner to accompany him on a trip back through time.

syfy.us.title: Silent House
syfy.us.description: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

syfy.us.title: Halloween II
syfy.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

syfy.us.title: American Sniper
syfy.us.description: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle (Bradley Cooper) takes his sole mission -- protect his comrades -- to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq. However, when he finally returns home, he finds that he cannot leave the war behind.

syfy.us.title: Die Hard With a Vengeance
syfy.us.description: Detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is now divorced, alcoholic and jobless after getting fired for his reckless behavior and bad attitude. He is called back into action, however, when a cryptic terrorist (Jeremy Irons) takes New York City hostage in a lethal game of "Simon Says" and refuses to speak with anyone but McClane. Teaming up with a street-savvy electrician named Zeus Carver (Samuel L. Jackson), McClane dashes through the city, trying to stay one step ahead of a murderous plot.

syfy.us.title: Live Free or Die Hard
syfy.us.description: As the nation prepares to celebrate Independence Day, veteran cop John McClane carries out another routine assignment: bringing in a computer hacker for questioning. Meanwhile, a tech-savvy villain named Thomas Gabriel launches an attack on America's computer infrastructure. As chaos descends around him, McClane must use old-fashioned methods to fight the high-tech threat.

syfy.us.title: American Sniper

syfywest.us.title: Safety Not Guaranteed
syfywest.us.description: A disaffected magazine intern (Aubrey Plaza) befriends an unusual guy (Mark Duplass), who is looking for a partner to accompany him on a trip back through time.

syfywest.us.title: Silent House
syfywest.us.description: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

syfywest.us.title: Halloween II
syfywest.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

syfywest.us.title: American Sniper
syfywest.us.description: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle (Bradley Cooper) takes his sole mission -- protect his comrades -- to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq. However, when he finally returns home, he finds that he cannot leave the war behind.

syfywest.us.title: Die Hard With a Vengeance
syfywest.us.description: Detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is now divorced, alcoholic and jobless after getting fired for his reckless behavior and bad attitude. He is called back into action, however, when a cryptic terrorist (Jeremy Irons) takes New York City hostage in a lethal game of "Simon Says" and refuses to speak with anyone but McClane. Teaming up with a street-savvy electrician named Zeus Carver (Samuel L. Jackson), McClane dashes through the city, trying to stay one step ahead of a murderous plot.

syfywest.us.title: Live Free or Die Hard
syfywest.us.description: As the nation prepares to celebrate Independence Day, veteran cop John McClane carries out another routine assignment: bringing in a computer hacker for questioning. Meanwhile, a tech-savvy villain named Thomas Gabriel launches an attack on America's computer infrastructure. As chaos descends around him, McClane must use old-fashioned methods to fight the high-tech threat. (movie) - 2007

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - I Sing the Body Electric
syfywest.us.description: A widower rents an android grandmother to take care of his three children. (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama) - 1962-05-18

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
syfywest.us.description: A man recovering from a nervous breakdown sees a horrifying creature on the wing of his plane. With William Shatner. (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama) - 2013-07-04

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - The Arrival
syfywest.us.description: An airline official tests his theory that a newly arrived but totally empty plane is imaginary-with startling results. (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama) - 1961-09-22

syfywest.us.title: The Twilight Zone - I Am the Night, Color Me Black
syfywest.us.description: On the morning that a man is to hang for killing one of his bigoted neighbors, the townspeople find themselves thrown into an unending night. (Anthology, Science fiction, Fantasy, Thriller, Drama) - 2013-08-25

talkingpictures.uk.title: Profile
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1954. Drama. Director Francis Searle and starring John Bentley, Kathleen Byron and Thea Gregory. The editor of a magazine is keen on the boss's daughter but her mother is keen on him.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Call Northside 777
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1948. Drama. Directed by Henry Hathaway. Stars James Stewart, Richard Conte & Helen Walker. A Chicago reporter looks into an old murder and realises the man jailed for the crime is innocent.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life Birdmen
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1963. A look at the origins of man-powered flight, focusing on John Wimpenny, the first man to pedal himself through the air for more than half a mile. Also featuring a look at today's attempts.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Weir's Way
talkingpictures.uk.description: Fast Castle to Abb's Head. 1981. Tom takes the 5 mile trek from the remarkable Fast Castle, built on crags and reckoned to have been built for shipwrecking, to the popular destination of St Abbs.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - A Bad Mistake
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1974. Stars Hilary Tindall, Gabrielle Drake & Colin Baker. Ann fears losing everything. Meanwhile, Edward meets prospective shareholders, but his honesty causes a setback.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Mark Saber - Saber at Sea
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Ann Stephens & Robert Arden. Saber helps a woman who has turned amateur detective upon finding a dead body aboard a cruise ship.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1975. Ronnie Hilton sings a number of hits, New World perform 'Kara, Kara' and 'Sister Jane'. David Copperfield, Valentino and Jimmy Marshall also star.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Unfaithfully Yours
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1984. Comedy. Directed by Howard Zieff. Stars Dudley Moore, Nastassja Kinski & Armand Assante. An orchestra conductor believes that his wife is cheating on him and concocts a plan to murder her.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Reckless Moment - 1949. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Max Ophuls. Stars James Mason, Joan Bennett & Geraldine Brooks. Finding her daughter's lover dead, a housewife takes desperate measures to protect her family from scandal.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Man Who Cheated Himself - 1950. Crime. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Felix E. Feist. Stars Lee J. Cobb, Jane Wyatt & John Dall. A homicide detective who witnesses his girlfriend kill her husband is assigned to the case, alongside his brother.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Portraits of Terror
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1957. Horror. Directed by Ed Wood Jr. Stars James 'Duke' Moore, Dudley Manlove & Jeannie Stevens. An actor roams an empty theatre after dark, where he is haunted by creepy sounds and eerie sights.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sergeant Cork
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Case of the Stage Door Johnnie. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Cicely Courtneidge. Kate Seymour is engaged to James Stratton, but she is receiving letters warning of his womanising.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Burke's Law - Who Killed Wimbledon Hastings?
talkingpictures.uk.description: Who Killed Wimbledon Hastings? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. An exploding tennis ball kill a tennis star at a charity event. Time for Burke to investigate.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Cat's Meow
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward, Julie Newmar & Sharyn Wynters. Catwoman steals Chad and Jeremy's voices and holds them for ransom.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Bat's Kow Tow
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1966. Stars Adam West, Julie Newmar & Ric Roman. Batman and Robin rush to the Policeman's Ball where Chad and Jeremy are singing but Catwoman is already there to cause mayhem.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Marked One - 1963. Crime. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Francis Searle. Stars William Lucas, Zena Walker & Patrick Jordan. Criminals kidnap a man's daughter in order to obtain forgery plates which they believe he possesses. (Mystery, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Movie) - 1988

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Agitator - 1945. Drama. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: John Harlow. Stars William Hartnell, Mary Morris & John Laurie. In this 'lost' William Hartnell film, a socialist inherits the British factory where he works as a union mechanic. (Movie)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Railway Murders - Death on the Underground
talkingpictures.uk.description: 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. The murder of 73 year old aristocrat Countess Teresa Lubienska on the eastbound Piccadilly line platform in 1957. (Crime, Documentary, Entertainment) - 2021

talkingpictures.uk.title: Paid
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1930. Drama. Directed by Sam Wood. Stars Joan Crawford, Robert Armstrong & Marie Prevost. Mary Turner, a wrongly accused ex-convict, seeks revenge on those who sent her to prison. (Crime, Drama, Movie) - 1930

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Italian Smokehouse
tastemade.us.description: Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes
tastemade.us.description: Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom.

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides
tastemade.us.description: Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni
tastemade.us.description: Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
tastemade.us.description: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie's ULTIMATE Autumn Garden FEAST!
tastemade.us.description: Jamie kicks off autumn with Italian-inspired cheesy cabbage pasta and smoky sweetcorn burgers with feta. He shares tips for storing onions and saving tomato seeds, finishing with a beautiful tomato galette for a perfect fall meal.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne
tastemade.us.description: Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta
tastemade.us.description: Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! He swaps turkey for a show-stopping festive porchetta, served with crispy roast potatoes. The menu also includes a veggie Brussels sprouts pie and a mulled wine pear pavlova.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Cajun-Style Grilled Wild Turkey & Creamy Tetrazzini
tastemade.us.description: Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
tastemade.us.description: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Most Underrated Game Bird
tastemade.us.description: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
tastemade.us.description: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Game Day Fried Squab
tastemade.us.description: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - A Whole Roasted Hog
tastemade.us.description: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Best Fish You're Not Eating
tastemade.us.description: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

themoviechannel.us.title: Godzilla
themoviechannel.us.description: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

themoviechannel.us.title: Paycheck
themoviechannel.us.description: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

themoviechannel.us.title: Kingpin
themoviechannel.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world.

themoviechannel.us.title: Old School
themoviechannel.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard.

themoviechannel.us.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
themoviechannel.us.description: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

themoviechannel.us.title: Footloose
themoviechannel.us.description: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way.

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike
themoviechannel.us.description: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

themoviechannel.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
themoviechannel.us.description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again.

themoviechannel.us.title: Surviving Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: A wealthy executive, Drew Latham has no close relationships and becomes nostalgic for his childhood home as Christmas approaches. When he visits the house and finds another family living there, he offers the residents, Tom Valco and his wife, Christine, a large sum of money to pretend they are his parents. Soon Drew tests the couple's patience, and, when their daughter, Alicia, arrives, things get increasingly tense. (movie) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Private Parts
themoviechannel.us.description: The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Demon Potato, Boozy Ballot and Ouija Believe It
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman inspects a seemingly possessed potato, examines an old chair connected to an intoxicating chapter in the life of George Washington and investigates the surprising origins of the world's most famous paranormal communication device.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Wallenda Walks, Crazy Taxi And Rest In Peat
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman examines a piece of cable used by a legendary aerialist during a high-wire walk, a French taxi that helped defeat the Germans during World War I and a piece of bone from a mysterious mass burial discovered in a Florida bog.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Swamp People, Walkie-Talkie Heist and Grant's Writing Water
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman examines an enigmatic canoe that unlocked the origins of a lost civilization, a miracle drug used by a Civil War hero in his last battle, and a bust involved in a supernatural game of chess.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Reckless, Thousand Island Dressing and the Tornado
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman examines a hero horse who risked her life, a culinary mystery about a popular salad dressing and an Olympic runner's battle with polio.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - The First Super Computer, Flying Under Fire and Dighton Rock
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman examines a boulder covered in strange carvings, which could turn American history on its head; a sword belonging to an explorer accused of treason; and the marble bust of a great leader who tried to untangle an ancient puzzle.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - King Neptune, Friday Night Bank Robber and Karluk's Last Voyage
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman examines a patriotic pig that helped fund World War II, a man's trek to rescue his crew during a brutal Arctic expedition, and two activists who risked their lives to take down a superpower and save the whales.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Jap Herron, Hidden Rockwell and Ticket to Fly
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman examines a novel supposedly written by the ghost of a legendary author, a painting that isn't quite what it seems and a replica of the plane that flew in the first commercial airline flight.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: Mysteries at the Museum - Operation Mincemeat, Texas Prison Rodeo and Tully Monster
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Don Wildman examines an enigmatic oar used in an unreal World War II deception, a gold nugget that helped set off the gold rush and a fossil belonging to one of history's strangest creatures.

thetravelchannelwest.us.title: America Declassified - Denver Airport Bunker; Nsa Data Center; White Sands Mysteries
thetravelchannelwest.us.description: Two mysterious Internet rumors are explained at America's largest military base.

thetravelchannelwest.us.description: John Wayne's death is examined; Jamestown settlers in 1609; the secrets of Pensmore.

thetravelchannelwest.us.description: A high security condo complex; the infamous 1962 breakout.

tlcwest.us.title: The Jennifer Hudson Show
tlcwest.us.description: Actors Chris Pratt and Jude Hill and author Jocko Willink ("Way of the Warrior Kid"); Jennifer has a special surprise in store for Chris Pratt; cook Billy Acosta, Carnitas El Momo, gets an incredible opportunity.

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way - The Parent Trapped
tlcwest.us.description: Jon and Ally brace for her family's reaction to the news; Kenny rushes to Hannah after a medical emergency, while Armando is stuck in Mexico; Jessy tries out for a beauty pageant; Nigel's baby plans surprise Andi; Zuri clashes with Ben's friends.

tlcwest.us.title: Sister Wives - Been There Done That
tlcwest.us.description: Christine, Janelle and Meri get together for the first time in years to share photos, which brings up old wounds for Christine and leaves Meri wanting a deeper conversation; Janelle is moving on from her divorce and visits a relationship consultant.

tlcwest.us.title: Sister Wives - Falling Into Old Feels
tlcwest.us.description: Meri celebrates her birthday with her chosen family of friends, and Janelle continues her journey of reinvention; the wives meet on video chat to share old recipes; Meri decides she needs to have a conversation with Christine.

tlcwest.us.title: Sister Wives - The Pink Elephant in the Room
tlcwest.us.description: Janelle continues to push outside her comfort zone and attends a line dancing event; Christine and David play a risqué board game to test their compatibility; Meri and Christine meet one-on-one to confront their tumultuous past.

tlcwest.us.title: Sister Wives - The Stench of a Failed Marriage
tlcwest.us.description: Meri and Christine find common ground as their conversation continues; Janelle faces her fear of bees and tries beekeeping with Maddie; the three ex-wives meet to melt down their wedding rings.

tlcwest.us.title: Sister Wives - Therapy By Fire
tlcwest.us.description: Meri, Janelle and Christine come together to burn jewelry from their marriages; Meri travels to San Francisco to take part in a tantra yoga speed-dating event; Christine and Janelle discuss polygamy while camping.

tlcwest.us.title: Sister Wives - What Did I Get Myself Into?
tlcwest.us.description: Meri steps out of her comfort zone and tries tantra yoga dating, which involves some uncomfortable hugging; Christine and Janelle go on an action-filled camping trip; Meri meets up with a man she connected with at speed dating.

tlcwest.us.title: Sister Wives - What Do You Wear On A Date
tlcwest.us.description: Janelle prepares to head to Vegas to meet up with her friend Alice, who's setting her up on a blind date; Meri hits the road with her friends to Oregon; David admits that Christine's past is too present in their lives, and they decide to start therapy.

tlcwest.us.title: 7 Little Johnstons - Your Whole Life Is About To Change
tlcwest.us.description: Newlyweds Liz and Brice have their hands full as they announce another baby on the way; Trent turns 50 and challenges himself to 50 new things; Amber struggles with menopause symptoms and tries new methods to relieve them.

tlcwest.us.title: 7 Little Johnstons - Go Ask Your Father
tlcwest.us.description: Pregnancy is hard, and Brice is on a mission; Amber has a few things to say about perimenopause; the guys learn about pregnancy with strap-on watermelons; Trent and Amber wonder: will their grandson be a little person?

tlcwest.us.title: My Big Fat Fabulous Life - Are You Pregnant?
tlcwest.us.description: Whitney has a brand-new life in Charlotte and a budding romance! But her dreams of motherhood are complicating her love life; and when Whitney's mystery man crashes her dance performance, she's forced to question if it's a situationship or something more.

tlcwest.us.title: My Big Fat Fabulous Life - He's My Friend That's a Boy
tlcwest.us.description: Jake crashes Whitney's halftime show against her wishes and outs them as an item to her unsuspecting family and friends; at Glenn's cookout, everyone grills Jake as Whitney worries they will expose her secret plan to have a baby on her own.

tlcwest.us.title: My Big Fat Fabulous Life - Extra Fabulous: This Feels Impulsive ᴺᵉʷ
tlcwest.us.description: With bonus scenes -- When Whitney's doctor prescribes a GLP-1 to help her get pregnant, will she take them and risk betraying the body positivity community? And when she's forced to reveal her pregnancy plans to Jake, his response leaves her speechless.

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day: Hunt for Love - More to Love: The Girl Who Saw Red ᴺᵉʷ
tlcwest.us.description: With bonus scenes -- A sexy double date brings some surprising revelations. Chloe and Jamal bond during a workshop, fueling Emma's jealousy. Steven breaks down over past mistakes, while Tanya's tough love forces Emma to question her future with Jamal.

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day: Hunt for Love - More to Love: The Girl Who Had Second Thoughts ᴺᵉʷ
tlcwest.us.description: With bonus scenes; Jamal and Emma reassess after a rocky workshop; Brittany and Ericka take things to the next level; Chloe and Kara explore other options; Razvan faces questions about his dating habits; Steven hits it off with someone new.

tntwest.us.description: As the team works to rescue a 5-year-old kidnapping victim, Scola suspects the boy's mother isn't being forthcoming about why her son was targeted; Nina struggles to open up to Scola about matters in their relationship.

tntwest.us.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
tntwest.us.description: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

tntwest.us.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus
tntwest.us.description: Sidelined by a nasty cold and feeling unneeded, Santa decides not to make his annual Christmas journey. Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

tntwest.us.title: The Polar Express
tntwest.us.description: When a doubting young boy takes a train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.

tntwest.us.title: Four Christmases
tntwest.us.description: When their plans for an exotic vacation fall apart, unmarried couple Brad (Vince Vaughn) and Kate (Reese Witherspoon) must spend Christmas Day trudging around to a quartet of family get-togethers. While Brad counts the hours till he can escape the onslaught of crazy relatives, Kate begins to wonder about her own choices and ponders whether her family members are so crazy after all.

tntwest.us.title: A Christmas Story
tntwest.us.description: Based on the humorous writings of author Jean Shepherd, this beloved holiday movie follows the wintry exploits of youngster Ralphie Parker (Peter Billingsley), who spends most of his time dodging a bully (Zack Ward) and dreaming of his ideal Christmas gift, a "Red Ryder air rifle." Frequently at odds with his cranky dad (Darren McGavin) but comforted by his doting mother (Melinda Dillon), Ralphie struggles to make it to Christmas Day with his glasses and his hopes intact.

tntwest.us.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
tntwest.us.description: As the holidays approach, Clark Griswold (Chevy Chase) wants to have a perfect family Christmas, so he pesters his wife, Ellen (Beverly D'Angelo), and children, as he tries to make sure everything is in line, including the tree and house decorations. However, things go awry quickly. His hick cousin, Eddie (Randy Quaid), and his family show up unplanned and start living in their camper on the Griswold property. Even worse, Clark's employers renege on the holiday bonus he needs.

tntwest.us.title: Elf
tntwest.us.description: Buddy (Will Ferrell) was accidentally transported to the North Pole as a toddler and raised to adulthood among Santa's elves. Unable to shake the feeling that he doesn't fit in, the adult Buddy travels to New York, in full elf uniform, in search of his real father. As it happens, this is Walter Hobbs (James Caan), a cynical businessman. After a DNA test proves this, Walter reluctantly attempts to start a relationship with the childlike Buddy with increasingly chaotic results.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Cyrus and Cambyses - Founders of the Empire
truehistory.us.description: Cyrus, the first great king of the Persian Empire, expands the empire through pragmatic leadership; he uses local customs and traditions and thereby gains legitimacy over Central Asia and Babylon; his son Cambyses expands the empire into Egypt.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Darius I - Creator of the Imperial System
truehistory.us.description: Whether Darius, the son-in-law of Cyrus, is a legitimate king; After Cambyses dies, Darius establishes himself as an unwavering leader; Darius creates a royal genealogy and a Persian identity; he then turns to building infrastructure.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Persian Capitals and Royal Palaces
truehistory.us.description: The five Persian capitals; Pasargadae, Ecbatana, Babylon, Susa and Persepolis; built in strategic, fortified locations, these cities are major symbols of power for the great kings; exploring the great hall at Persepolis, which holds 10,000 guests.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - The Great King - Images and Realities
truehistory.us.description: Seeing beyond the outside stereotypes of Persian kings as tyrants; seeing what the kings themselves have to say; in sculpted reliefs and carvings on royal tombs, the words and images of Darius and Xerxes show Persian values of harmonious cooperation.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Royal Roads and Provinces
truehistory.us.description: A trip into the western provinces; the empire's diverse local customs; the Persian Empire is famous for its roads and bridges; how its express messenger system allows information to travel quickly; the king keeps tabs on every corner of the empire.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Taking On the Other Side of History
truehistory.us.description: The past comes alive when considering the imaginary lives of ordinary people; these include the citizens, soldiers and slaves who live on the other side of history; asking questions that many textbooks never ask.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Being Paleolithic
truehistory.us.description: Taking a look at the lives of human ancestors; picturing oneself as a Neanderthal, whose life is dominated by the environment; discovering the significance of the human mind, language and art in the Old Stone Age.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Living in Mesopotamia
truehistory.us.description: Stepping into the world's earliest permanent settlement; why the development of agriculture is a revolution; the invention of writing; the creation of laws; an increase in trade; technological innovations such as the wheel.

truehistory.us.title: The Other Side of History: Daily Life in the Ancient World - Being Egyptian
truehistory.us.description: What it is like to be an ancient Egyptian; exploring everyday life during the New Kingdom era; the richness of the Nile; the conservatism and stability of the society; relics that survive across millennia, such as hieroglyphics, papyri and art.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - The Importance of the West
truehistory.us.description: An overview of the past 500 years of European history and culture; the system of government; economic structures; science and technology; the literature, art and music.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - Geography Is Destiny
truehistory.us.description: How the physical realities of Europe and the Atlantic world shaped its destiny; geography and climate affecting patterns of population, immigration, diplomacy, war, and political and cultural divisions.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - Culture Is Destiny
truehistory.us.description: The Great Chain of Being, which assumed an ordered, hierarchical universe in which humans were placed in a particular rank by God; Europe emerging from the Middle Ages; how the concept was challenged and strained by various forces.

truehistory.us.title: Foundations of Western Civilization II: A History of the Modern Western World - Renaissance Humanism - 1350 - 1650
truehistory.us.description: A revived interest in the literary and historical works of classical Greece and Rome; new ideas about the qualifications of a gentleman, the role of women and the expectations of a prince; a resulting emphasis on literacy and education.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - A Middle East Crossroads in the Year 1900
truehistory.us.description: How western imperialism, the politics of oil, and the push for a Jewish state all set the stage for the 20th century.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - Constitutional Revolts in Persia and Turkey
truehistory.us.description: How protests in Persia led to a new government; then why the Young Turks wanted a united Turkey to supersede the Ottoman Empire.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - World War I and the Ottoman Empire's Fall
truehistory.us.description: The promises of Arab and Turkish nationalism and the construction of a Jewish state collide after the war.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - Egyptian Revolution and Turkish Independence
truehistory.us.description: The fallout from World War I with a look at the Turkish War of Independence in 1919, as well as anti-British uprisings from Egypt to Iraq.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - Monarchies of the 20th-Century Middle East
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the monarchies in the Middle East and North Africa in the period between the World Wars.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - The Muslim Brotherhood and Its Founder
truehistory.us.description: Imam Hassan al-Banna is the founder of the Muslim Brotherhood.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - World War II Fault Lines in the Middle East
truehistory.us.description: A high-level look at World War II and its impact on the Middle East and North Africa.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - European Anti-Semitism and Israel's Birth
truehistory.us.description: Tracing the development of Israel up to the creation of the state in 1948.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - Industrialization Is Good for You
truehistory.us.description: Stepping into the story of one of the greatest periods in history; investigating why people should be grateful for the Industrial Revolution, even though there is much to dislike about industrialization.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - Why Was Britain First?
truehistory.us.description: Starting at the beginning in the British Isles; various factors contribute to the birth of the Industrial Revolution, including relative political stability, sophisticated financial institutions, colonial trade and a rising population of workers.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - The Agricultural Revolution
truehistory.us.description: In Britain in the 18th century, new agricultural methods come into being; a look at some of these changes to agriculture, including different uses of the land, the introduction of new crops and the early mechanization of farming.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - Cities and Manufacturing Traditions
truehistory.us.description: Traversing the country to see where industry takes off; starting with a detailed look at the advantages and dangers of life in London; shifting attention to provincial cities and towns, where industrialists face various challenges.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - The Royal Shipyards
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the world of 18th-century shipyards, where large-scale organization provides a blueprint for later factory-era industrialization; how ships are made; the challenges shipbuilders face, such as fires, rot and decay.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - The Textile Industry
truehistory.us.description: Turning to the actual process of industrialization that begins in the textile business; surveying the work of spinning and weaving textiles; learning about several key inventors; their innovations, such as the flying shuttle and the spinning jenny.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - Coal Mining
truehistory.us.description: Coal mining becomes a large-scale capitalist enterprise; diving into one of the most dangerous jobs in the world; the problems miners have to overcome; examining some of the solutions; learning about steam engines, safety lamps, ventilation and more.

truehistory.us.title: The Industrial Revolution - Iron - Coking and Puddling
truehistory.us.description: Iron is an important raw material for the Industrial Revolution; the history of iron; how to produce pig iron and forge wrought iron; meeting many of the key innovators who improve the process of bringing higher-quality iron into a growing market.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - A Middle East Crossroads in the Year 1900
truehistory.us.description: How western imperialism, the politics of oil, and the push for a Jewish state all set the stage for the 20th century.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle East in the 20th Century - Constitutional Revolts in Persia and Turkey
truehistory.us.description: How protests in Persia led to a new government; then why the Young Turks wanted a united Turkey to supersede the Ottoman Empire.

trutv.us.title: Miracle
trutv.us.description: When college coach Herb Brooks (Kurt Russell) is hired to helm the 1980 U.S. men's Olympic hockey team, he brings a unique and brash style to the ice. After assembling a team of hot-headed college all-stars, who are humiliated in an early match, Brooks unites his squad against a common foe, the heavily-favored Soviet team. trutvwest.us.description: Joe, Q, Sal, and Murr crack each other up from behind glass, then test out awkward proposals; plus, the big loser gets tongue-tied while speaking to government officials; Joey Fatone goes behind the scenes on "After Party."

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Card Against Humanity
trutvwest.us.description: Q, Murr, Joe and Sal eavesdrop on strangers' conversations; the big loser gives out a single business card at a networking event.

trutvwest.us.title: Impractical Jokers - The Running of the Bullies
trutvwest.us.description: Q, Murr, Joe and Sal offer up peculiar specials at a steakhouse and get creepy while helping to clean a prop house; the big loser realizes he may need his own lifeguard after making waves at the pool.

trutvwest.us.title: Miracle
trutvwest.us.description: When college coach Herb Brooks (Kurt Russell) is hired to helm the 1980 U.S. men's Olympic hockey team, he brings a unique and brash style to the ice. After assembling a team of hot-headed college all-stars, who are humiliated in an early match, Brooks unites his squad against a common foe, the heavily-favored Soviet team. As the U.S. squad tries to overcome insurmountable odds and win the gold medal, the team becomes a microcosm for American patriotism during the Cold War.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Brigadoon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tommy Albright (Gene Kelly) and Jeff Douglas (Van Johnson), two American pals on a Scottish hunting trip, get lost in the woods and come upon the magical village of Brigadoon. Rising out of the Scottish mist only once every 100 years, and only for one day, Brigadoon is an enchanted place where life is simpler and easier, untouched by the worries of the modern world. When Tommy falls for beautiful villager Fiona Campbell (Cyd Charisse), he must decide whether to stay or to return to his life.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Annie Get Your Gun
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The musical tale of Annie Oakley (Betty Hutton) moves from stage to screen in this rollicking film adaptation. Renowned in the Wild West as a sharpshooter, Annie meets her match, both romantically and professionally, in the form of fellow ace gunslinger Frank Butler (Howard Keel). While Annie and Frank are performing as part of the famous traveling show headlined by the legendary Buffalo Bill (Louis Calhern), the two compete and flirt, with plenty of ups and downs along the way.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: During the 1850s, Milly (Jane Powell), a pretty young cook, marries Adam (Howard Keel), a grizzled woodsman, after a brief courtship. When the two return to Adam's farm, Milly is shocked to meet his six ill-mannered brothers, all of whom live in his cabin. She promptly begins teaching the brothers proper behavior, and most importantly, how to court a woman. But after the brothers kidnap six local girls during a town barn-raising, a group of indignant villagers tries to track them down.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Meet Me in St. Louis
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: "Meet Me in St. Louis" is a classic MGM romantic musical comedy that focuses on four sisters (one of whom is the nonpareil Judy Garland) on the cusp of the 1904 St. Louis World's Fair. The film spotlights the sisters' education in the ways of the world, which includes, but isn't limited to, learning about life and love, courtesy of the prototypical boy next door. In the end, love -- accompanied by song, dance and period costumes, all in glorious Technicolor -- conquers all.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wizard of Oz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a tornado rips through Kansas, Dorothy and her dog, Toto, are whisked away in their house to the magical land of Oz. They follow the Yellow Brick Road toward the Emerald City to meet the Wizard, and en route they meet a Scarecrow that needs a brain, a Tin Man missing a heart, and a Cowardly Lion who wants courage. The wizard asks the group to bring him the broom of the Wicked Witch of the West to earn his help.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Four Seasons
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jack (Alan Alda) and Kate (Carol Burnett) traditionally go on vacation with their friends every new season. Old friend Nick (Len Cariou) surprises everyone when he arrives not with his wife, Anne (Sandy Dennis), but with his new girlfriend, the much younger Ginny (Bess Armstrong). The group -- all of which had grown to be good friends with Anne -- must come to terms with this unexpected development. Ultimately, they learn to accept Nick's decision, and work to welcome Ginny as a friend.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Annie
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds. (movie) - 1982

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Who's Been Sleeping in My Bed?
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jason Steel (Dean Martin) plays a wise, confident and handsome doctor on television — but besides the handsome part, that's where the comparisons end. In real life, Jason is scatterbrained and unsure about his impending marriage to Melissa (Elizabeth Montgomery), a gorgeous art teacher who most men would kill for. However, he may get a little sage advice of his own when he finds himself the de facto consultant for a group of married women who confuse his screen persona with reality. (movie) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: My Fair Lady
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this beloved musical, pompous phonetics professor Henry Higgins (Rex Harrison) is so sure of his abilities that he takes it upon himself to transform a Cockney working-class girl into someone who can pass for a cultured member of high society. His subject turns out to be the lovely Eliza Doolittle (Audrey Hepburn), who agrees to speech lessons to improve her job prospects. Higgins and Eliza clash, then form an unlikely bond -- one that is threatened by an aristocratic suitor (Jeremy Brett). (movie) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lili
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Traveling with little more than her naïveté, sunny teenager Lili (Leslie Caron) arrives in a new town and is befriended by a circus troupe. Though she becomes infatuated with the dashing magician, Marcus the Magnificent (Jean-Pierre Aumont), Lili forms a more significant bond with puppeteer Paul (Mel Ferrer) and his four puppets, which she treats as real people. Together, Lili, Paul and the puppets prove to be a popular act, but their success and happiness are threatened by Paul's gruffness. (movie) - 1953

tvasports.ca.title: Canada in the Rough
tvasports.ca.description: Cette émission canadienne de chasse présente les majestueuses montagnes Rocheuses de la Colombie-Britanique, les horizons sans fin des Prairies, les mystérieux marais de Terre-Neuve, la mystique forêt boréale du Bouclier Canadien en Ontario et la beauté désertique de l'Arctique. Chaque semaine, une chasse extraordinaire pour une espèce différente de gibier est présentée. Chaque épisode s'efforce d'éduquer, d'informer et de divertir à travers l'équilibre unique de l'expérience de chasse combinée aux interactions humaine et biologique avec les espèces chassées.

tvasports2.ca.description: L'équipe met à l'essai le nouveau Honda CR-V Trail Sport ; la catégorie des utilitaires compacts est très populaire et très compétitive ; est-ce que le Honda CR-V Trail Sport a ce qu'il faut pour détrôner le Toyota RAV4 ? On en fait l'analyse.

tvasports2.ca.title: L'académie du guide de l'auto: formule Grand Prix - Demi-finale explosive: deux finalistes sur quatre iront en grande finale... qui craquera?
tvasports2.ca.description: Nos quatre demi-finalistes montent à bord de la Hyundai Ioniq 5-N; épreuves de braquage et qualifications sur piste ovale: quel duo ira en finale du championnat? Antoine nous présente la voiture de la semaine et Rosalie nous entraîne en Éthiopie.

tvasports2.ca.title: Long Range Hunter
tvasports2.ca.description: L'animateur et chasseur Pierre Lefebvre nous convie à un rendez-vous hebdomadaire. Avec ses invités, il parcourt les plus beaux endroits de chasse au pays.

tvasports2.ca.title: Québec à vol d'oiseau
tvasports2.ca.description: Les plus belles aventures de chasse et de pêche.

tvasports2.ca.title: Canada in the Rough
tvasports2.ca.description: Cette émission canadienne de chasse présente les majestueuses montagnes Rocheuses de la Colombie-Britanique, les horizons sans fin des Prairies, les mystérieux marais de Terre-Neuve, la mystique forêt boréale du Bouclier Canadien en Ontario et la beauté désertique de l'Arctique. Chaque semaine, une chasse extraordinaire pour une espèce différente de gibier est présentée. Chaque épisode s'efforce d'éduquer, d'informer et de divertir à travers l'équilibre unique de l'expérience de chasse combinée aux interactions humaine et biologique avec les espèces chassées.

tvasports2.ca.title: Les cascades gelées
tvasports2.ca.description: Le grimpeur professionnel Will Gladd tente de devenir la première personne à gravir les chutes du Niagara en hiver.

tvasports2.ca.title: JiC
tvasports2.ca.description: Avec une liste impressionnante de collaborateurs, Jean-Charles Lajoie aborde le sport sous tous ses angles à sa manière, dans un univers télévisuel éclaté.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - The Bet
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan navigates his relationship with Jessica and a developing rapport with Grace while working a high-stakes criminal case involving an undercover homeland security agent; Officer Chen meddles with Officer Bradford's love life.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Warriors and Guardians
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan gets off to a rocky start after being introduced to his new training officer; Officer Bradford struggles to think of an appropriate birthday gift for Rachel; Officer Lopez finds herself navigating a case that triggers a personal memory.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Tough Love
uptv.us.description: The rookies are asked to develop their first confidential informants; Officer Chen's mother complicates her home life when she comes to stay with her.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Fallout
uptv.us.description: An emergency alert of an impending missile attack sends Los Angeles into chaos and uncertainty, while the officers each try to keep the peace and deal with their own disasters.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Safety
uptv.us.description: John and Jessica's relationship gets a lot more complicated after she delivers some surprising news; Officer Bradford and Officer West are assigned a community policing project helping out the Watts Rams as volunteer coaches.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Clean Cut
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan kicks off his birthday by babysitting a crime scene at a law office; Officer Bradford and Officer West are set to receive special awards; Sgt. Grey rides patrol with Officer Harper after she requests an early annual evaluation.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Breaking Point
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan's trust is tested when he tries to help the previous owner of his home reconnect with his family; Officer Harper's overnight visit with her daughter is put into jeopardy when her past undercover life resurfaces again.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - The Dark Side
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan and the team are charged with escorting a notorious female serial killer to the graves of her victims; Officer Chen meets a seemingly perfect man who sparks her interest; Officer Lopez worries about Wesley.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Day of Death
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan and the entire team are in a desperate search to rescue Officer Chen after her abduction; Officer Lopez discovers Wesley unconscious from a dangerous cocktail of alcohol and pills.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Now and Then
uptv.us.description: Nolan takes his son's fiancée, Abigail, on a ride-along after she shows interest in becoming a police officer; Jackson's relationship becomes increasingly complicated.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Follow-Up Day
uptv.us.description: Nolan is given some life-changing news and invites Grace over for a home-cooked meal in his newly remodeled kitchen; each unit is tasked with following up on dormant cases in hopes of uncovering new leads.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Casualties
uptv.us.description: Officers Nolan and Harper investigate a murder which may have national security implications; Officer Bradford must confront his past when he crosses paths with a homeless veteran.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Hand-Off
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan learns his identity has been stolen and could jeopardize his position as an officer; Sgt. Grey must testify at the parole hearing of the man who shot him and murdered his partner.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - The Overnight
uptv.us.description: Officers Chen and Bradford respond to a call at the Los Angeles auditions of "American Idol" and Officer Chen ends up facing Ryan Seacrest and the judges; Chen befriends a reporter whose motives are not clear.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Control
uptv.us.description: Officer Nolan's relationship with his first confidential informant is tested when he discovers her back on the street dealing drugs; Lucy's fear of dating following her abduction is beginning to threaten her friendship with Jackson.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - Under the Gun
uptv.us.description: Officers Nolan and Harper escort four juvenile offenders to a Scared Straight program at a correctional facility, but it quickly becomes a riotous situation; Nolan is uncertain about Grace after she fails to introduce him to her ex-husband.

uptv.us.title: The Rookie - The Q Word
uptv.us.description: Officers Nolan, Chen and West are squeezed harder than ever before as their training officers evaluate whether they are truly ready for the job; one of the rookie classmates is involved in a shooting.

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - Día del trabajo
usanetwork.us.description: Durante una prueba en su nuevo puesto, Nolan investiga la muerte sospechosa de un agente. El parto en casa de Harper se vuelve caótico. Chen recibe una oferta tentadora.

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - La novata
usanetwork.us.description: Al policía John Nolan se le asigna su primera novata, la agente Celina Juárez, cuyo enfoque poco convencional del trabajo policial plantea un desafío único para él.

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - La elección
usanetwork.us.description: Rosalind vuelve con todo y la vida de Bailey pende de un hilo.

usanetwork.us.title: Suits - Punto de quiebre
usanetwork.us.description: Harvey recibe el encargo de tratar de lograr la emancipación de un adolescente, estrella del tenis, a quien su padre le prohíbe hacerse profesional.

usanetwork.us.title: Suits - Jugárselo todo
usanetwork.us.description: Harvey y Mike se enfrentan a un caso poco ortodoxo, mientras que Louis y Rachel hacen equipo. Por su parte, Jessica se mete en problemas defendiendo a la firma.

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - El fugitivo
usanetwork.us.description: Nolan y Juárez persiguen a un fugitivo tras producirse un incidente automovilístico. Un fantasma del pasado atormenta el presente de Tim y Lucy.

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - Ajuste de cuentas
usanetwork.us.description: Nolan y Celina investigan un depósito de dinero en efectivo relacionado con un antiguo caso de la DEA. Wesley está cada vez más preocupado por su declaración y se sorprende cuando se da cuenta de que el abogado de Elijah es alguien de su pasado.

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - Fuego cruzado
usanetwork.us.description: El agente John Nolan y Celina son testigos de un tiroteo, pero descubren que la víctima ya estaba muerta. Bailey se siente incómoda desde que recibió la propuesta y Nolan se pregunta qué puede hacer para que se sienta mejor.

usanetwork.us.title: Blue Bloods - Ciudad sin piedad

usanetwork.us.title: Blue Bloods - Explosión del pasado

usanetwork.us.title: Blue Bloods - Al borde del abismo

usanetwork.us.title: Suits - Golpe inesperado

usanetwork.us.title: Suits - Rebobinado

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - La captura

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - Reclamar

usanetwork.us.title: The Rookie - La lista

wafb.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wafb.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. wbbjdt3.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wbbjdt3.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wbng.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
wbng.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wbtv.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wcbi.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wcbi.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wdbj.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wdbj.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wecpld.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wecpld.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

An employee of the Dukes, Winthorpe is framed by the brothers for a crime he didn't commit, with the siblings then installing the street-smart Valentine in his position. When Winthorpe and Valentine uncover the scheme, they set out to turn the tables on the Dukes.

wetv.us.title: Last Holiday
wetv.us.description: The discovery that she has a terminal illness prompts introverted saleswoman Georgia Byrd (Queen Latifah) to reflect on what she realizes has been an overly cautious life. So Georgia withdraws her life savings and jets off to Europe where she lives like a millionaire. Upbeat and passionate, Georgia charms everybody she meets, including renowned Chef Didier (Gérard Depardieu). The only one missing from her new life is her longtime crush Sean Matthews (LL Cool J).

wfmy.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
wfmy.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wfmy.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wfmy.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wgme.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wgme.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wifrld.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wifrld.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wivbdt.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wivbdt.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.
