wjz.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wjz.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wloxdt2.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wloxdt2.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wltx.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
wltx.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wmbd.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wmbd.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wncn.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
wncn.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wncn.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wncn.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wohl2sd.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wohl2sd.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wpec.us.title: Let's Make a Deal ᴺᵉʷ
wpec.us.description: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

wpec.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wpec.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wpec.us.title: The NFL Today
wpec.us.description: Get ready for all of Sunday's game action on CBS with "The NFL Today." Hosted by James Brown, the hourlong show presents a mix of features, highlights, predictions and the latest news from across the league. Analysts alongside Brown include Nate Burleson, Bill Cowher, Russell Wilson and Kyle Long.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wrsp.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
wrsp.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series.

wsaw.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wsaw.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wshmld.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wshmld.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wtaj.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wtaj.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wtkr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wtvy.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wtvy.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

wvlt.us.title: The Price Is Right ᴺᵉʷ
wvlt.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

documentary+.us.title: The Last Blockbuster
documentary+.us.description: The manager of the last Blockbuster video store struggles to keep the store open.

documentary+.us.title: Fantastic Fungi
documentary+.us.description: The magical world of fungi and their power to heal, sustain and contribute to the regeneration of life on Earth.

documentary+.us.title: Age of Audio
documentary+.us.description: The resurgence of audio storytelling. From a vivid passion to an extraordinary billion-dollar industry.

documentary+.us.title: Lisa Dahl: Blessed by Grace
documentary+.us.description: The journey of Lisa Dahl, who turned personal tragedy into a culinary career.

documentary+.us.title: Pickle Man
documentary+.us.description: When faced with certain death by ALS, photographer-turned-local legend Arthur Cohen decides to leave a legacy of pickles -- PickALS, that is.

documentary+.us.title: Nurse: Empathy Heals
documentary+.us.description: While people may think they know what nurses do, "Nurse: Empathy Heals" reveals what nurses face daily when caring for their patients: personal stories that reveal moments of doubt, faith, grief, joy and fierce love.

documentary+.us.title: A Swim Lesson
documentary+.us.description: An ode to an everyday hero: Bill Marsh, a swim teacher who helps children manage their fears.

documentary+.us.title: The Reality of Hope
documentary+.us.description: Virtual reality creator Hiyu is facing kidney failure. His online friend Photographotter travels from New York City to Stockholm to be a live donor to Hiyu.

documentary+.us.title: Talking Drum
documentary+.us.description: Explore the healing power of drumming through community leaders using the universal language of rhythm.

documentary+.us.title: NFX
documentary+.us.description: Neurofibromatosis affects individuals with a genetic disease that causes tumors; these are their stories.

documentary+.us.title: After Skid Row
documentary+.us.description: For over a decade, Barbie Carter was among the thousands on individuals living on Skid Row, Los Angeles. After being approved for housing, she forges a bond with an aid worker, and together they work to keep her off the streets.

documentary+.us.title: The Blessings Of Aging
documentary+.us.description: The sweet and sassy residents of a retirement community explain the many upsides of getting older.

documentary+.us.title: Shadows In Sunlight
documentary+.us.description: In Pakistan, a vaccination health-worker risks her life in the battle to eradicate polio.

documentary+.us.title: Hi I'm Blake
documentary+.us.description: After a gymnastics accident leaves him severely brain-damaged, Blake Hyland creates a platform to bring awareness and hope to everyone he meets on the road to recovery while his family wrestles to restore him to his former self.

documentary+.us.title: Dancing Warrior
documentary+.us.description: On Pine Ridge Reservation, Lakota teens find hope racing horses in Indian Relay.

documentary+.us.title: Blind AF
documentary+.us.description: A Paralympian sets out to become the first blind person to ride a single, non-tandem, bike across the U.S.

documentary+.us.title: Row of Life
documentary+.us.description: Angela Madsen, a Paralympian and Marine veteran, set out to be the first paraplegic and oldest woman to row the Pacific Ocean alone.

documentary+.us.title: Resynator
documentary+.us.description: When her genius inventor father dies, a daughter finds his old synth prototype, sparking a quest to learn his secrets and forge a posthumous connection.

BBC4.uk.title: Yellowstone: Wildest Winter to Blazing Summer - The Wildest Winter
BBC4.uk.description: Patrick Aryee follows the grizzly bears that are taking a risk with the weather by leaving their winter dens early. Hungry wolves are struggling to bring down their elk prey in the unusually shallow snow. For great grey owls, it is the iciness of the snow that is hampering their hunts.

BBC4.uk.title: The Eagle Has Landed (1977)
BBC4.uk.description: A crack troop of Nazi paratroopers is sent to England to kidnap Winston Churchill and transport him to Germany. An English-hating Irishman is recruited by the Germans to spearhead the plan. If the attempt to snatch the British Prime Minister succeeds, the course of the war could be altered. Can the plot be stopped? Based on the fanciful bestseller by Jack Higgins.

BBC4.uk.title: Scene by Scene - David Lynch
BBC4.uk.description: Mark Cousins meets US director David Lynch, creator of such idiosyncratic and groundbreaking screen landmarks as `Eraserhead', `Blue Velvet' and `Twin Peaks'.

BBC4.uk.title: Blue Velvet (1986)
BBC4.uk.description: When Jeffrey Beaumont discovers a severed ear in a field, his curiosity leads him into the world of extreme violence and weird sex controlled by Frank Booth, a criminal totally out of control, and Dorothy Vallens, a damsel in distress who seems to be in his thrall - or is she.

BBC4.uk.title: Arena - Dickens on Film
BBC4.uk.description: From the magical films of the silent era to the celebrated work of director David Lean and high definition television, this documentary revisits films and interviews from the archive to answer the question of why Dickens's novels have inspired so many hundreds of adaptations on screen.

BBC4.uk.title: Earth's Natural Wonders - Surviving Against the Odds
BBC4.uk.description: In some natural wonders people push themselves to the limit to survive. For the people who call these extraordinary places home, survival requires skill, Ingenuity and bravery. These places include Brazil, Ethiopia, Laos, and Switzerland.
